0182d1f23cb7.en: At dawn, the maids leave for home

026b420d703e.en: Itanema asks, seemingly out of nowhere, but with a decent amount of backstory behind it: "Sora, don't you want to go home to your parents?" Sora shies away and hugs her pillow. "Running from it all again… It's not working, is it?" Aurora sits by Sora and rests Sora's head on her breasts. "C'mon, Itanema, leave her alone. Sora, no rush." "No rush? Are we planning to live like we're in cooking and accounting school for the rest of our lives?" "It's not so bad. I do feel pretty safe." Itanema disagrees, but says nothing. A knock on the door.
026b420d703e.t: Itanema bertanya, tampak tiba-tiba, tapi dengan latar belakang yang cukup panjang: "Sora, kamu tidak ingin pulang ke orang tuamu?" Sora menghindar dan memeluk bantalnya. "Lari dari semuanya lagi… Tidak berhasil, kan?" Aurora duduk di samping Sora dan menyandarkan kepala Sora di dadanya. "Ayolah, Itanema, biarkan dia. Sora, tidak usah buru-buru." "Tidak usah buru-buru? Apa kita berencana hidup seolah-olah kita di sekolah memasak dan akuntansi seumur hidup?" "Tidak seburuk itu. Aku merasa cukup aman." Itanema tidak setuju, tapi tidak bilang apa-apa. Ketukan di pintu.

0376d412f4aa.en: Kibe and his guard captains go through their daily work
0376d412f4aa.t: Kibe dan para kapten penjaganya menjalani pekerjaan harian mereka

037814020734.en: "Just—just one more thing. I'm nominating Kibe as my apprentice." Kibe, walking off in the distance, thinks his ears just stopped working. "Kibe is exceptional at following specific directions, so he'd be my perfect right hand. On which note, I'll also officially introduce a vote to rename the position." The crowd stares at Kibe. "What?" Huneo smiles: "Pay will be the same as an apprentice's." Kibe shudders.
037814020734.t: "Satu—satu hal lagi. Saya menunjuk Kibe sebagai murid saya." Kibe, yang sedang berjalan menjauh, mengira telinganya baru saja berhenti bekerja. "Kibe luar biasa dalam mengikuti arahan yang spesifik, jadi ia akan menjadi tangan kanan saya yang sempurna. Sekalian, saya juga akan secara resmi mengajukan pemungutan suara untuk mengganti nama jabatan itu." Kerumunan menatap Kibe. "Apa?" Huneo tersenyum: "Bayarannya akan sama dengan bayaran murid." Kibe bergidik.

04ff14d0e6e4.en: Eiri holds back a smile. "If you're so sorry, then you'll come live with me." The maids laugh. Sora, relieved but apprehensive: "Yes, Big Momma." "Good. You're all free to go home in the morning. But! The guards will still go with you for a while, until I figure out this fishy smell." Sora: "Itanema already did." "Really? I'm all ears, then."
04ff14d0e6e4.t: Eiri menahan senyum. "Kalau kamu memang menyesal, kamu akan tinggal bersamaku." Para pelayan tertawa. Sora, lega tapi waswas: "Baik, Emak Besar." "Bagus. Kalian semua boleh pulang besok pagi. Tapi! Para penjaga tetap ikut kalian untuk sementara, sampai aku tahu bau amis ini dari mana." Sora: "Itanema sudah tahu." "Sungguh? Aku mendengarkan, kalau begitu."

04ffd1cf0e22.en: (Art note: maybe add a Wozen nari gel mix to her: make it cute, but show the Magina man is into weird kinks.)
04ffd1cf0e22.t: (Catatan gambar: mungkin tambahkan campuran nari gel Wozen padanya: buat imut, tapi tunjukkan pria Magina itu punya fetish aneh.)

0652ae8104e9.en: Morika has finished burying Gabiro's research. Posaqui: "Yessu! I laid a total of thirty-five misdirections for the adventurers." Namia: three adventurers stumbled onto where Sinoi was held captive, but found nothing new.
0652ae8104e9.t: Morika sudah selesai mengubur riset Gabiro. Posaqui: "Siap! Aku memasang total tiga puluh lima pengalih perhatian untuk para petualang." Namia: tiga petualang menemukan tempat Sinoi ditawan, tapi tak menemukan apa pun yang baru.

0710bd0d13e7.en: Ryo stops the wagon and tries to talk to her, but she only calls for her sister before collapsing on him. "Get me some nari gel. ASAP!"
0710bd0d13e7.t: Ryo menghentikan gerobaknya dan mencoba bicara dengannya, tapi gadis itu hanya memanggil saudarinya sebelum ambruk menimpanya. "Ambilkan aku nari gel. SEGERA!"

072133fcbf76.en: Trembling with rage, Eori lifts Huneo off the ground, moments from giving him free dental work— "You're no better than them, Princess Eori." Neferteri's cold voice reaches her, and a flood of memories hits: her hot blood is no different from her sisters'. Itagiba: "Them? Ohhhh. That's low," but it goes unheard. Eori shoves Huneo away and storms out.
072133fcbf76.t: Gemetar karena amarah, Eori mengangkat Huneo dari tanah, sesaat lagi akan memberinya perawatan gigi gratis— "Kamu tidak lebih baik dari mereka, Putri Eori." Suara dingin Neferteri menjangkaunya, dan banjir ingatan menghantam: darah panasnya tak berbeda dari darah kakak-kakaknya. Itagiba: "Mereka? Ohhhh. Itu keterlaluan," tapi tak terdengar. Eori mendorong Huneo menjauh dan pergi dengan marah.

0748b6c46635.en: His body convulses. His mouth clamps shut on his own tongue, bloody foam forming around it, suffocating him. The gurgling stops as his lungs fill up. He calms down, and falls into a sound sleep, somewhere in the forest. (Clodoveu and Wilson are gone for good.)
0748b6c46635.t: Tubuhnya kejang. Mulutnya mengatup menjepit lidahnya sendiri, busa berdarah terbentuk di sekitarnya, mencekiknya. Suara berdeguk berhenti saat paru-parunya penuh. Ia tenang, dan tertidur lelap, di suatu tempat di hutan. (Clodoveu dan Wilson tiada untuk selamanya.)

07caa2ee21a8.en: Clodoveu: "Uffda. That was pretty good. Ohh? That took some of your energy, huh? Wilson! Cold Water! Wilson!" He looks back and sees Wilson fleeing for his life. "Haaaa, you dickass. I'm gonna remember that!" He readies his hand and cracks his neck. "Well, I'm dead either way."
07caa2ee21a8.t: Clodoveu: "Waduh. Itu cukup bagus. Ohh? Itu menguras sebagian energimu, ya? Wilson! Cold Water! Wilson!" Ia menoleh ke belakang dan melihat Wilson kabur menyelamatkan nyawanya. "Haaaa, dasar bajingan. Akan kuingat itu!" Ia menyiapkan tangannya dan meregangkan lehernya. "Yah, aku mati juga, bagaimanapun."

08b6c4d64fd9.en: Silent tears pour down Katsuki's face as her hands calm down. "One. Trust broken. Two. No sister."
08b6c4d64fd9.t: Air mata mengalir diam-diam di wajah Katsuki saat tangannya tenang. "Satu. Kepercayaan hancur. Dua. Bukan saudari."

08c20d5cb177.en: Everything is freshly demolished: blood and chunks of bodies everywhere. Katsumi looks distraught, the adventurer confused, and Ryo curious. Ryo: "Maybe one of them is {WIP-maginafarmBoss}?" Adventurer: "I'm not healing bandits! That's where I draw the line." "I never said that! So, where do you think she is?" Katsumi: "In the bedroom!"
08c20d5cb177.t: Semuanya baru saja hancur: darah dan potongan tubuh di mana-mana. Katsumi tampak terguncang, si petualang bingung, dan Ryo penasaran. Ryo: "Mungkin salah satunya {WIP-maginafarmBoss}?" Petualang: "Aku tidak menyembuhkan bandit! Di situ batasku." "Aku tidak pernah bilang begitu! Jadi, menurutmu di mana dia?" Katsumi: "Di kamar tidur!"

0a59d5cae6b5.en: Morika comes in to feed her; she gets aggressive, and it turns violent. He knocks her out. Nobody can really deal with her, so they pour Black Honey down her throat.
0a59d5cae6b5.t: Morika masuk untuk memberinya makan; ia menjadi agresif, dan berubah menjadi kekerasan. Morika membuatnya pingsan. Tak ada yang benar-benar bisa menghadapinya, jadi mereka menuangkan Black Honey ke tenggorokannya.

0aac3b337d8f.en: "Go suck a big fat—" Marcus, meanwhile, takes a nari gel from his pocket, dips another knife in it and throws it at Harry as he gets ready to charge again. Marcus steps back for distance and readies another knife, then sees a fireball forming between Harry's tusks, speeding toward him. He launches the knife; they meet midway and explode in a curtain of fire. Marcus flips Harry off. "Fuck—" Something large flies through the curtain of flame.
0aac3b337d8f.t: "Isap saja yang besar dan gem—" Marcus, sementara itu, mengambil nari gel dari sakunya, mencelupkan pisau lain ke dalamnya, dan melemparnya ke Harry saat Harry bersiap menerjang lagi. Marcus mundur untuk menjaga jarak dan menyiapkan pisau lain, lalu melihat bola api terbentuk di antara taring Harry, melesat ke arahnya. Ia melontarkan pisaunya; keduanya bertemu di tengah dan meledak menjadi tirai api. Marcus mengacungkan jari tengah ke Harry. "Sial—" Sesuatu yang besar melayang menembus tirai api.

0b15ffe8389c.en: Huneo sets a Nari Refresher on the table near her. "You're doing this to yourself. Respect me, and I'll respect you." Silent, eyes bloodshot, her arm pumping blood with every heartbeat. He leaves. "You'd better heal yourself and clean up before you pass out and die. Guards, don't let her leave. I'll have Eiri bring her dinner here."
0b15ffe8389c.t: Huneo menaruh Nari Refresher di meja dekatnya. "Anda yang melakukan ini pada diri sendiri. Hormati saya, dan saya akan menghormati Anda." Diam, matanya merah, lengannya memompa darah di setiap detak jantung. Ia pergi. "Sebaiknya Anda menyembuhkan diri dan bersih-bersih sebelum Anda pingsan dan mati. Penjaga, jangan biarkan dia pergi. Saya akan menyuruh Eiri membawakan makan malamnya ke sini."

0c1217744332.en: A sinking feeling sets in, getting worse with every step: thick saliva, a clenched throat, a turning stomach. He holds onto a tree and pukes his guts out, weaker than before, then wanders on, aimless, under graying skies.
0c1217744332.t: Perasaan tenggelam mulai muncul, makin parah di setiap langkah: air liur kental, tenggorokan tercekat, perut bergolak. Ia berpegangan pada pohon dan memuntahkan isi perutnya, lebih lemah dari sebelumnya, lalu berkeliaran lagi, tanpa tujuan, di bawah langit yang makin kelabu.

0ce262b8144c.en: Huneo comes in with a Sanbi guard and looks around. "You'll have to pay for all this damage too, Princess Eori." Rage rises; she starts toward him, then stops: the guards have arrows aimed at her head. "I've received permission to do as I please to guarantee my safety." Huneo smiles, almost enjoying putting her in her place.
0ce262b8144c.t: Huneo masuk bersama seorang penjaga Sanbi dan melihat sekeliling. "Anda juga harus membayar semua kerusakan ini, Putri Eori." Amarah memuncak; ia mulai mendekat, lalu berhenti: para penjaga membidikkan anak panah ke kepalanya. "Saya sudah mendapat izin untuk melakukan apa pun yang saya mau demi menjamin keselamatan saya." Huneo tersenyum, nyaris menikmati menempatkannya di tempatnya.

0dde1c23faf8.en: Eiri: "Next matter: Fanchaki. Gabiro's Fanchaki research isn't panning out the way he envisioned. The new Fanchakis are juicier and thicker, but they're more willing to fight back now, and they seem to have more Soul Energy too." "Are we still profiting?" "Yes, but I forecast breaking even, or a loss, if the amount of nari gel stone keeps going up." "Why?" "Healing. The Fanchakis have gotten more aggressive, as if they realized they're being culled." Itagiba: "Well, I can still spin that as a positive. I vote we just release them into the wild when we stop making money." Huneo has grievances, but it's three against one. Eiri: "Next topic: Harry."
0dde1c23faf8.t: Eiri: "Urusan berikutnya: Fanchaki. Riset Fanchaki Gabiro tidak berjalan seperti yang ia bayangkan. Fanchaki baru lebih berair dan lebih tebal dagingnya, tapi kini lebih mau melawan, dan tampaknya Energi Jiwanya juga lebih banyak." "Apa kita masih untung?" "Ya, tapi aku memperkirakan impas, atau rugi, kalau jumlah batu nari gel terus naik." "Kenapa?" "Penyembuhan. Fanchaki jadi lebih agresif, seolah mereka sadar sedang dimusnahkan." Itagiba: "Yah, aku masih bisa memutarnya jadi hal positif. Aku memilih kita lepaskan saja mereka ke alam liar saat kita berhenti untung." Huneo punya keberatan, tapi tiga lawan satu. Eiri: "Topik berikutnya: Harry."

0fb866625abc.en: Neferteri dodges the questions to get Huneo off her trail, and Itagiba covers for her with the same story he gave everyone else. Eiri wants to come clean, but cowers under Neferteri's gaze.
0fb866625abc.t: Neferteri mengelak dari pertanyaan-pertanyaan itu agar Huneo tidak membuntutinya, dan Itagiba melindunginya dengan cerita yang sama yang ia berikan kepada semua orang. Eiri ingin berterus terang, tapi ciut di bawah tatapan Neferteri.

0fe30f71299f.en: {WIP-maginafarmBoss}, the farm's boss, gets up after being slammed into the wall; Harry, seen from behind, is nearly spent
0fe30f71299f.t: {WIP-maginafarmBoss}, bos ladang itu, bangun setelah dibanting ke dinding; Harry, terlihat dari belakang, nyaris kehabisan tenaga

108ec496671e.en: Forest all around. What should I do? Where do I go? He sees the sisters again in his mind, and remembers the moment Katsumi kicked him out.
108ec496671e.t: Hutan di mana-mana. Apa yang harus kulakukan? Ke mana aku pergi? Ia melihat kedua saudari itu lagi di benaknya, dan teringat saat Katsumi mengusirnya.

10ac32f1686f.en: "Say, do you guys have a many-husbands policy or what?" Severino: "What does that have to do with anything?" "Just curious. There are like 10 guys for every woman here." "I see what you're saying. Most of the women and children are hidden in the barracks behind us." "Got it. You guys—"
10ac32f1686f.t: "Omong-omong, kalian punya aturan banyak suami atau apa?" Severino: "Apa hubungannya dengan semua ini?" "Cuma penasaran. Ada sekitar 10 pria untuk setiap wanita di sini." "Aku mengerti maksudmu. Kebanyakan wanita dan anak-anak disembunyikan di barak di belakang kami." "Mengerti. Kalian—"

10b0d9a34240.en: Eiri: "On the budget side, how much are you asking for?" "20 Sapphires up front, plus 5 Sapphires a week." "A week? Our weekly gains are around 2 right now! I can do 5 weeks of that, at most, without straining our coffers." Neferteri: "As Eiri so eloquently put it. You could assign your own guards to hunt down Gabiro's research." "Those guards are already protecting the city. I need more resources."
10b0d9a34240.t: Eiri: "Dari sisi anggaran, berapa yang kamu minta?" "20 Sapphire di muka, ditambah 5 Sapphire seminggu." "Seminggu? Pendapatan mingguan kita sekitar 2 saat ini! Aku bisa memberi itu paling lama 5 minggu tanpa membebani kas kita." Neferteri: "Seperti yang dikatakan Eiri dengan begitu fasih. Kamu bisa menugaskan penjagamu sendiri untuk memburu riset Gabiro." "Para penjaga itu sudah melindungi kota. Saya butuh lebih banyak sumber daya."

135b86eb5118.en: Clodoveu and Wilson, holding his nose, stand ready with buckets. Dried blood and dirt cloud the water dripping off Harry. Clodoveu: "Hey there! Sorry about the water, but we don't want you setting the basement on fire." Wilson: "Phew. Did you ever take a bath? My man, you stink like ass! Like an ass left to rot in the sun."
135b86eb5118.t: Clodoveu dan Wilson, sambil menutup hidung, berdiri siap dengan ember. Darah kering dan tanah mengeruhkan air yang menetes dari tubuh Harry. Clodoveu: "Halo! Maaf soal airnya, tapi kami tidak mau kamu membakar ruang bawah tanah ini." Wilson: "Fiuh. Kamu pernah mandi? Bung, baumu seperti pantat! Seperti pantat yang dibiarkan membusuk di bawah matahari."

13758efa5b4a.en: One Bagarisa stands up, its back lit on fire. The others notice too, and get defensive.
13758efa5b4a.t: Seekor Bagarisa berdiri, punggungnya menyala terbakar. Yang lain juga menyadarinya, dan bersiaga.

138b10a96ce3.en: Clodoveu rushes Harry, who crosses his arms in an X to defend. Clodoveu looks at the X, then at his lower body, stops midway and lets his two-handed mace fly at Harry's gut. Harry's big arm drops and takes the brunt: flesh, bone and soul fire fly everywhere.
138b10a96ce3.t: Clodoveu menerjang Harry, yang menyilangkan lengannya membentuk X untuk bertahan. Clodoveu menatap X itu, lalu tubuh bagian bawahnya, berhenti di tengah jalan dan membiarkan gada dua tangannya melayang ke perut Harry. Lengan besar Harry turun dan menahan pukulan itu: daging, tulang, dan api jiwa beterbangan ke mana-mana.

13a377623aa5.en: The map: the target is Maicon's warehouse

156beb60fa5b.en: Clodoveu: "So yeah. You're in no position to make requests, but if you spill everything you know, I'll let you join the team." Wilson: "You sure?" Clodoveu nods. "So, Harry?" Harry pictures the Bagarisas' happy little smiles. "You fucking killed them! I'm not joining you!" "That's too bad. Then I've got no choice but to make you meet the darkness." Clodoveu readies his weapon while Wilson grabs a bucket.
156beb60fa5b.t: Clodoveu: "Jadi ya. Kamu tidak dalam posisi untuk meminta, tapi kalau kamu menceritakan semua yang kamu tahu, aku akan membiarkanmu bergabung dengan tim." Wilson: "Kamu yakin?" Clodoveu mengangguk. "Jadi, Harry?" Harry membayangkan senyum kecil bahagia para Bagarisa. "Kalian membunuh mereka, sialan! Aku tidak mau bergabung dengan kalian!" "Sayang sekali. Kalau begitu aku tak punya pilihan selain membuatmu menemui kegelapan." Clodoveu menyiapkan senjatanya sementara Wilson mengambil ember.

16b643973657.en: Neferteri stands and hugs her. "As Queen of Sanbi, I hereby relieve you of your research duties." Tears run down her face as the memory of a dead fetus creeps back: Eori was pregnant when Arukia killed her in Vol 3, and when Morika revived her, her body rejected and expelled the fetus. Neferteri saw the corpse of what would have been her first grandchild, and told Morika to dispose of it properly. "I'm sorry, Eori. I should have known."
16b643973657.t: Neferteri berdiri dan memeluknya. "Sebagai Ratu Sanbi, dengan ini aku membebaskanmu dari tugas risetmu." Air mata mengalir di wajahnya saat ingatan tentang janin yang mati merayap kembali: Eori sedang hamil saat Arukia membunuhnya di Jilid 3, dan saat Morika menghidupkannya kembali, tubuhnya menolak dan mengeluarkan janin itu. Neferteri melihat jasad dari yang seharusnya menjadi cucu pertamanya, dan menyuruh Morika menguburkannya dengan layak. "Maafkan aku, Eori. Seharusnya aku tahu."

183c9d45f2a2.en: "All right! FINE! SUIT YOURSELF!" Katsumi runs, biting her lips in anger, but her sister's face keeps haunting her. She trips into the mud, too weak to get up, and feels something sharp poke her back.
183c9d45f2a2.t: "Baiklah! TERSERAH! SESUKAMU!" Katsumi berlari, menggigit bibirnya karena marah, tapi wajah saudarinya terus menghantuinya. Ia tersandung ke lumpur, terlalu lemah untuk bangun, dan merasakan sesuatu yang tajam menusuk punggungnya.

185de30320e3.en: She chews the flowers as the screams and the fight draw closer, lying with her arms wide open, staring vacantly at the ceiling. A loud fire roars outside, followed by a crash against the wall. It doesn't scare her, not even when the bookshelf comes crashing down on her. Her exposed hand shows bits of flower petals as blood pours out.
185de30320e3.t: Ia mengunyah bunga-bunga itu saat jeritan dan perkelahian makin dekat, berbaring dengan lengan terbuka lebar, menatap kosong ke langit-langit. Api besar menderu di luar, disusul hantaman ke dinding. Itu tidak menakutinya, bahkan saat rak buku runtuh menimpanya. Tangannya yang terlihat memperlihatkan serpihan kelopak bunga saat darah mengucur.

18c01809afdb.en: Huneo goes through the stockpile Gabiro and Kibe left behind and hands her a paper. "First, I want an updated inventory of everything here by the deadline." "That's impossible!" "That's an order. Make it happen." She looks at the guard's hand on his sword and forces herself not to explode.
18c01809afdb.t: Huneo memeriksa persediaan yang ditinggalkan Gabiro dan Kibe dan memberinya selembar kertas. "Pertama, saya ingin inventaris terbaru dari semua yang ada di sini sebelum tenggat." "Itu mustahil!" "Itu perintah. Wujudkan." Ia menatap tangan penjaga di pedangnya dan memaksa dirinya tidak meledak.

194a8fd7b913.en: Wilson keeps a makeshift scoreboard, half dozing. Harry feels anger, power, a monster in Clodoveu. The fist lands right on Harry's crossed arms and slams them into his face, knocking him back. His vision flickers; he feels like puking his breakfast when a hand reaches toward him.
194a8fd7b913.t: Wilson memegang papan skor darurat, setengah terkantuk. Harry merasakan amarah, kekuatan, monster dalam diri Clodoveu. Tinju itu mendarat tepat di lengan Harry yang bersilang dan menghantamkannya ke wajahnya, membuatnya terpental. Penglihatannya berkedip; ia merasa ingin memuntahkan sarapannya saat sebuah tangan terulur ke arahnya.

1953363d75e4.en: Dalila's father, Laramy, is an older gentleman. Dalila: "Mom! Can we stop by Jack Wood?" Her mom, Honati, squeezes her round cheeks. "Anything for my little chubby." Dalila, flustered, pushes her hands away. "You're embarrassing me!"
1953363d75e4.t: Ayah Dalila, Laramy, adalah pria yang lebih tua. Dalila: "Ibu! Boleh kita mampir ke Jack Wood?" Ibunya, Honati, mencubit pipinya yang bulat. "Apa saja untuk si gembulku." Dalila, malu, menepis tangannya. "Ibu bikin aku malu!"

19e1fb5e6675.en: He can't move. One of the Bagarisas farts. He shakes himself loose and stands up, and realizes the fost stone lamp went out overnight.
19e1fb5e6675.t: Ia tak bisa bergerak. Salah satu Bagarisa kentut. Ia menggoyang dirinya sampai lepas dan berdiri, lalu sadar lampu batu fost padam semalam.

1a08a0dea39a.en: "Life is all about eating or getting eaten. Eori ate you plenty of times, but did you ever eat her back?" Harry imagines eating her pussy and laughs. "I guess so?" Clodoveu smirks too. "Let me rephrase. Did you want to eat her? Do you love her?" Harry feels a stab in his heart, not from loneliness, but from fear of what she could do to him if she ever found him. "Hmmm hmm." "There's your answer. Somewhere in this world, you'll find the thing you want to eat most. I already found mine, but he didn't want to eat me back. Now I'm looking for the second-best thing."
1a08a0dea39a.t: "Hidup itu soal makan atau dimakan. Eori sudah sering memakanmu, tapi apa kamu pernah memakannya balik?" Harry membayangkan menjilati memeknya dan tertawa. "Kurasa begitu?" Clodoveu juga menyeringai. "Biar kuulangi. Apa kamu ingin memakannya? Apa kamu mencintainya?" Harry merasakan tusukan di hatinya, bukan karena kesepian, tapi karena takut akan apa yang bisa ia lakukan kepadanya kalau ia sampai menemukannya. "Hmmm hmm." "Itu jawabanmu. Di suatu tempat di dunia ini, kamu akan menemukan hal yang paling ingin kamu makan. Aku sudah menemukan milikku, tapi dia tidak mau memakanku balik. Sekarang aku mencari yang terbaik kedua."

1ba746dcb010.en: Katsumi drags Katsuki along until Katsuki pulls free and stops dead. "ONE! ENOUGH! TWO! KILL—ME!" Katsumi slaps her and pulls, but she won't budge, and walks toward the oncoming bandits.
1ba746dcb010.t: Katsumi menyeret Katsuki sampai Katsuki melepaskan diri dan berhenti mendadak. "SATU! CUKUP! DUA! BUNUH—AKU!" Katsumi menamparnya dan menariknya, tapi ia tak mau bergerak, dan berjalan ke arah para bandit yang mendekat.

1ce7303b3c94.en: The door closes. Itagiba: "He's stealing my thunder, honey. I think you were right after all." Neferteri: "I see this as a chance to bring some of those values into our guild." "And end up like your parents? That sucks." "Everything in moderation, my dear. There's a reason I'm here, and not there." Itagiba flexes his beefy arms. "Is it because of these two bad boys?" Neferteri cracks a jovial smile. "There's more to it than that. Now, shall we get on with the day?" "You betcha."
1ce7303b3c94.t: Pintu tertutup. Itagiba: "Dia mencuri panggungku, sayang. Kurasa kamu benar juga." Neferteri: "Aku melihat ini sebagai kesempatan membawa sebagian nilai-nilai itu ke dalam gilda kita." "Dan berakhir seperti orang tuamu? Itu payah." "Segala sesuatu secukupnya, sayangku. Ada alasannya aku di sini, dan bukan di sana." Itagiba memamerkan lengannya yang berotot. "Apa karena dua jagoan ini?" Neferteri tersenyum riang. "Lebih dari itu. Sekarang, bagaimana kalau kita lanjutkan hari ini?" "Tentu saja."

1d64c561b188.en: Katsumi mouths off and draws the bandits' ire. When she refuses to come work at their farm and they realize the two are Red Winga whores, they draw their swords.
1d64c561b188.t: Katsumi bermulut lancang dan memancing amarah para bandit. Saat ia menolak bekerja di ladang mereka dan mereka sadar keduanya pelacur Red Winga, mereka menghunus pedang.

1db7f1b7ba4c.en: Breathing hard, he feels the pain the adrenaline had been holding back dequeue into his mind all at once. His feet are the worst: they've been leaking blood for a while, leaving a trail that quickly blends into the sea of leaves on the chilly wind.
1db7f1b7ba4c.t: Terengah-engah, ia merasakan rasa sakit yang tadi ditahan adrenalin membanjiri pikirannya sekaligus. Kakinya yang terparah: sudah lama mengucurkan darah, meninggalkan jejak yang cepat membaur dengan lautan daun di tengah angin yang dingin.

1e54d6d88b18.en: Harry wakes to a Bagarisa kissing him and pushes it away, screaming: they kind of stink. It oinks at him, as if complaining about the bad treatment.
1e54d6d88b18.t: Harry bangun karena seekor Bagarisa menciumnya dan mendorongnya pergi sambil menjerit: baunya agak busuk. Bagarisa itu menguik kepadanya, seolah mengeluhkan perlakuan buruk itu.

1ef7434d628a.en: Neferteri: from now on, they'll let the quest go stale and give her daughter's heart time to heal. Their next orders: find Harry and Sinoi. All three are to go fully back to their adventurer roles and cast a wide net across the kingdom. She hands out the only badge they have, which is Harry's, and cuts their stipend in half: the new courtroom scientist is relentless about probing Eiri for spending records.
1ef7434d628a.t: Neferteri: mulai sekarang, mereka akan membiarkan misi itu basi dan memberi hati putrinya waktu untuk sembuh. Perintah mereka berikutnya: temukan Harry dan Sinoi. Ketiganya harus kembali sepenuhnya ke peran petualang mereka dan menebar jaring luas di seluruh kerajaan. Ia memberikan satu-satunya lencana yang mereka punya, yaitu milik Harry, dan memotong tunjangan mereka separuh: ilmuwan istana yang baru tanpa henti mengorek catatan pengeluaran dari Eiri.

1f0392960420.en: Itagiba and Neferteri, one on one

1f4cacb24a9f.en: Harry hesitates; Marcus stabs him in the shoulder. "I'm not fucking around! Where is {WIP-oldHagLootHouse}?" Clodoveu taps Marcus's shoulder, and Marcus shoves him off. "Fuck off, you fag. I'm talking here." Clodoveu raises his hands and sits down. Marcus grips the mohawk so tight Harry feels his scalp coming unglued.
1f4cacb24a9f.t: Harry ragu; Marcus menusuk bahunya. "Aku tidak main-main! Di mana {WIP-oldHagLootHouse}?" Clodoveu menepuk bahu Marcus, dan Marcus mendorongnya menjauh. "Minggir, banci. Aku sedang bicara." Clodoveu mengangkat tangannya dan duduk. Marcus mencengkeram mohawk itu begitu erat sampai Harry merasa kulit kepalanya hampir copot.

1f83626049d8.en: Kibe: "I'm out." Someone in the crowd: "Man! You suck!" A tall, strong Darfaries: "Yeah! I'll give you an Amethyst if you can suck me as much as you sucked at this job! Hahaha!" Kibe pauses, almost as if taking a mental picture of him, before leaving the stage.
1f83626049d8.t: Kibe: "Aku keluar." Seseorang di kerumunan: "Bung! Kamu payah!" Seorang Darfaries yang tinggi dan kuat: "Ya! Kukasih satu Amethyst kalau kamu bisa mengisap kontolku sejago kamu payah di pekerjaan ini! Hahaha!" Kibe terdiam, nyaris seolah sedang memotret pria itu di dalam benaknya, sebelum turun dari panggung.

1ff45ed70cf9.en: "I never agreed to anything like that." Eori, slouched in her chair with her arms crossed, draws everyone's attention, and her mother's disapproving look. Neferteri: "This is no longer a matter of agreeing, but of doing." "THEN I DON'T WANNA DO IT!" She heads out.
1ff45ed70cf9.t: "Aku tidak pernah menyetujui hal seperti itu." Eori, merosot di kursinya dengan lengan bersilang, menarik perhatian semua orang, dan tatapan tidak setuju ibunya. Neferteri: "Ini bukan lagi soal setuju, melainkan soal melakukan." "KALAU BEGITU AKU TIDAK MAU MELAKUKANNYA!" Ia beranjak keluar.

211f00b05d57.en: Katsumi smiles at him. "So you wanna see my new special move?" "Ohh, yeah? I'll be waiting." He smacks his lips and walks off light-footed, as if he'd just won the lottery. "I promise you won't forget it." He rubs his crotch. "I'm gonna skip the booze to give you my special ability too." Katsumi keeps smiling. Shit. I might've pushed it too far.
211f00b05d57.t: Katsumi tersenyum kepadanya. "Jadi kamu mau lihat jurus spesial baruku?" "Ohh, ya? Aku akan menunggu." Ia berdecak dan pergi dengan langkah ringan, seolah baru menang lotre. "Aku janji kamu tak akan melupakannya." Ia menggosok selangkangannya. "Aku tidak akan minum supaya bisa memberimu kemampuan spesialku juga." Katsumi terus tersenyum. Sial. Mungkin aku keterlaluan.

21f1d37a8f90.en: Eori shuts down. "I need to find Harry first." Maiara loses it. "All right, that's it! He was supposed to be MY husband!" "He's not!" "Yeah? Then why are you so obsessed with him?" "I AM NOT! HE'S A NO—I WANT HIM AS A RESEARCH ASSISTANT!"
21f1d37a8f90.t: Eori menutup diri. "Aku harus menemukan Harry dulu." Maiara meledak. "Baiklah, cukup! Dia seharusnya jadi suamiKU!" "Bukan!" "Oh ya? Lalu kenapa kamu begitu terobsesi padanya?" "AKU TIDAK! DIA BUKAN SIAPA-SI—AKU MENGINGINKANNYA SEBAGAI ASISTEN RISET!"

22e8027cecaa.en: Arc #2 - Hifuna Beast: the author's story notes (spoilers).
22e8027cecaa.t: Arc #2 - Makhluk Buas Hifuna: catatan cerita penulis (spoiler).

22ed03f88caa.en: Wrapped in a cloth against the cold, Harry smells the freshly cooked, seasoned meat wrapped in cornmeal, and his stomach growls violently, but the image of the dead Bagarisas makes him ill. He turns his head. Marcus: "I wish I had friends this good." He eats the meat right in front of Harry, savoring the juiciness. Harry flares up again.
22ed03f88caa.t: Terbungkus kain melawan dingin, Harry mencium daging yang baru dimasak dan dibumbui, dibungkus tepung jagung, dan perutnya bergemuruh hebat, tapi bayangan Bagarisa yang mati membuatnya mual. Ia memalingkan kepala. Marcus: "Andai aku punya teman sebaik ini." Ia memakan daging itu tepat di depan Harry, menikmati kelezatannya. Harry berkobar lagi.

22ee764ba13f.en: Eori's anger rises as she seems to realize she has lost her last defense. Now everyone has turned on her, and on Harry.
22ee764ba13f.t: Amarah Eori memuncak saat ia tampaknya sadar telah kehilangan pertahanan terakhirnya. Kini semua orang berbalik melawannya, dan melawan Harry.

24fff589839c.en: Sora gasps. "Then how did she have time to make all those nari gels, being that lovey-dovey?" "It's all about love—and you lost your chance, since he's not coming back for a maid." Sora turns red with shame. "Still rubs you the wrong way? Then ask him to rub you the right way." Eiri laughs, but it ends in a sad smile, remembering how she coerced Harry into signing the contract. I'm sorry, Harry. I hope you decided to flee it all instead… She has a guard escort Sora back to the dormitory: she has a few things to talk about with Eori.
24fff589839c.t: Sora terkesiap. "Lalu bagaimana dia sempat membuat semua nari gel itu, kalau semesra itu?" "Semua itu soal cinta—dan kamu sudah kehilangan kesempatanmu, karena dia tidak akan kembali demi seorang pelayan." Wajah Sora memerah karena malu. "Masih bikin kesal? Kalau begitu minta dia mengelusmu dengan cara yang benar." Eiri tertawa, tapi berakhir dengan senyum sedih, teringat bagaimana ia memaksa Harry menandatangani kontrak itu. Maafkan aku, Harry. Kuharap kamu memutuskan kabur dari semua ini saja… Ia menyuruh seorang penjaga mengantar Sora kembali ke asrama: ada beberapa hal yang harus ia bicarakan dengan Eori.

255b70271289.en: An adventurer sends the Winga up. It flies above the trees, looks around, and barks over and over as it heads back. "Speed it up! Something dangerous is coming!" "I can't go any faster!" "I'm gonna Create Hail." The other adventurer: "All right. I'll Decrease Gravity on the cart, then get a shock ready." They do; the Winga's barking grows louder and faster.
255b70271289.t: Seorang petualang menerbangkan Winga. Winga itu terbang di atas pepohonan, melihat sekeliling, dan menggonggong berulang-ulang saat kembali. "Percepat! Ada sesuatu yang berbahaya datang!" "Aku tak bisa lebih cepat lagi!" "Aku akan Create Hail." Petualang yang lain: "Baiklah. Aku akan Decrease Gravity pada gerobak, lalu menyiapkan setrum." Mereka melakukannya; gonggongan Winga makin keras dan makin cepat.

271769f39b6a.en: A knock: Eiri. "Hey, got time to spare?" "I'm busy." "All right, all right. I came to ask about Harry." Eori turns. "What do you want?" "So what was your relationship with him? Did you break up with him, or what?"
271769f39b6a.t: Ketukan: Eiri. "Hei, punya waktu luang?" "Aku sibuk." "Baiklah, baiklah. Aku datang untuk bertanya soal Harry." Eori berbalik. "Mau apa?" "Jadi apa hubunganmu dengannya? Kamu putus dengannya, atau bagaimana?"

27883fc55be5.en: Everyone approves except Neferteri, who drills Huneo with questions. Eiri asks if she suspects him; Neferteri says it's all happening too fast.
27883fc55be5.t: Semua menyetujui kecuali Neferteri, yang memberondong Huneo dengan pertanyaan. Eiri bertanya apakah ia mencurigainya; Neferteri bilang semuanya terjadi terlalu cepat.

28d376c6fcf9.en: {WIP-maginafarmBoss} steps back, and an explosion sends him (or rather a chunk of him) and everyone around flying in all directions. The pressure wave destroys everything else, while putting out all the flames. Everything grows quiet.
28d376c6fcf9.t: {WIP-maginafarmBoss} mundur, dan sebuah ledakan membuatnya (atau lebih tepatnya sepotong tubuhnya) dan semua orang di sekitarnya terpental ke segala arah. Gelombang tekanan menghancurkan semua yang lain, sekaligus memadamkan semua api. Semuanya menjadi hening.

2b8aec035b77.en: "See? I told ya, it's just a matter of connecting the dots. Now, Sora, can you put some sense into Eiri and stop her Big Momma behavior?" Sora still can't swallow it. "Then why didn't Arukia ever contact us?" "Why would she? I'd find it weird if she suddenly wasn't private about her life."
2b8aec035b77.t: "Lihat? Sudah kubilang, cuma soal menghubungkan titik-titiknya. Sekarang, Sora, bisa kamu sadarkan Eiri dan hentikan kelakuan sok emaknya itu?" Sora masih tak bisa menerimanya. "Lalu kenapa Arukia tak pernah menghubungi kita?" "Kenapa harus? Aku malah merasa aneh kalau dia tiba-tiba tidak tertutup soal hidupnya."

2c43660cbd0f.en: "Hey, fuckface! Can't you see they're Red Winga property?" "So what? They're whores anyway!" "Red Winga whores! Can't you imagine how much info they have?" "And?" "And we can get information out of them, you retarded Brunto. Let's go! I knew I'd spotted gold."
2c43660cbd0f.t: "Hei, muka kontol! Kamu tidak lihat mereka milik Red Winga?" "Terus kenapa? Toh mereka pelacur!" "Pelacur Red Winga! Kamu tidak bisa bayangkan berapa banyak informasi yang mereka punya?" "Terus?" "Terus kita bisa mengorek informasi dari mereka, dasar Brunto tolol. Ayo! Sudah kuduga aku menemukan emas."

2e15405cdcd8.en: Itagiba asks if they're doing the right thing with Eori. Neferteri says it'll keep her mind busy: she needs to forget Harry. Itagiba wonders whether forcing her into a position is best for her. Neferteri says she knows best, and won't let the same emotional outbursts happen to Eori.
2e15405cdcd8.t: Itagiba bertanya apakah mereka melakukan hal yang benar terhadap Eori. Neferteri bilang itu akan membuat pikirannya sibuk: ia perlu melupakan Harry. Itagiba bertanya-tanya apakah memaksanya ke suatu jabatan yang terbaik untuknya. Neferteri bilang ia paling tahu, dan tak akan membiarkan ledakan emosi yang sama terjadi pada Eori.

2ee62d5abbd4.en: Blood drips from her. She blinks, and Harry is gone; she tries to find him, but her eyes are too fuzzy. She blinks again, and sees wild animals eating her parents.
2ee62d5abbd4.t: Darah menetes darinya. Ia berkedip, dan Harry sudah hilang; ia berusaha menemukannya, tapi matanya terlalu buram. Ia berkedip lagi, dan melihat hewan-hewan liar memakan orang tuanya.

30d8891f83d6.en: "So, about Kozaku. Why does he look like that?" "Walking Heart. Never heard of them?" Harry shakes his head. "That's why he had a flame on his heart. It looks like your flame, but the interface is totally different." "So he was a scientific experiment?" "Oh, no. He sought out one of those stones in the Hifuna region and replaced his heart with it, and once it was in, it melded with him. Now he's not really a Darfaries, more like a Walking Flathead." "What?" "Never heard of them either? Were you born yesterday?" Harry laughs. "I only remember things since summer, so kind of."
30d8891f83d6.t: "Jadi, soal Kozaku. Kenapa dia tampak begitu?" "Walking Heart. Belum pernah dengar?" Harry menggeleng. "Itulah sebabnya ada api di jantungnya. Mirip apimu, tapi antarmukanya sama sekali berbeda." "Jadi dia eksperimen ilmiah?" "Oh, bukan. Dia mencari salah satu batu itu di wilayah Hifuna dan mengganti jantungnya dengan batu itu, dan begitu terpasang, batu itu menyatu dengannya. Sekarang dia bukan benar-benar Darfaries, lebih mirip Walking Flathead." "Apa?" "Belum pernah dengar juga? Kamu lahir kemarin?" Harry tertawa. "Aku hanya ingat hal-hal sejak musim panas, jadi kurang lebih begitu."

31115fe51886.en: Eori points at the office next door, the king and queen of Sanbi's. "They said no to raising it too?" Eiri slowly nods, with a hum that confirms Eori's suspicion. Eori turns to leave without a word; her anger seems to make the room's gravity heavier. "Wait! Please keep this between us, okay?" Eori glances back with bloodthirsty eyes, then leaves without a word.
31115fe51886.t: Eori menunjuk kantor di sebelah, kantor raja dan ratu Sanbi. "Mereka juga menolak menaikkannya?" Eiri mengangguk pelan, dengan gumaman yang membenarkan kecurigaan Eori. Eori berbalik pergi tanpa sepatah kata; amarahnya seolah membuat gravitasi ruangan lebih berat. "Tunggu! Tolong rahasiakan ini di antara kita, oke?" Eori menoleh dengan mata haus darah, lalu pergi tanpa sepatah kata.

311d650285c6.en: Neferteri calmly applauds. "Thank you, Princess Nina. Based on y—" Eori feels the end of the line coming; she bursts into tears, crying like a child caught stealing candy.
311d650285c6.t: Neferteri bertepuk tangan dengan tenang. "Terima kasih, Putri Nina. Berdasarkan k—" Eori merasakan akhirnya sudah dekat; tangisnya pecah, menangis seperti anak yang ketahuan mencuri permen.

311d65894514.en: A piercing jab plows through his stomach. Behind him, a ghostly white figure smirks. He forces his flat right hand through that shit-eating smile and deep into its mouth, feels something spongy and warm calling to be grabbed and pulled, and does. The smile turns to pure agony.
311d65894514.t: Tusukan tajam menembus perutnya. Di belakangnya, sosok putih seperti hantu menyeringai. Ia memaksa tangan kanannya yang rata menembus senyum menjijikkan itu dan masuk dalam ke mulutnya, merasakan sesuatu yang kenyal dan hangat seolah memanggil untuk dicengkeram dan ditarik, dan ia melakukannya. Senyum itu berubah menjadi penderitaan murni.

316169bc2b0f.en: Harry and the Bagarisas are getting each other's rhythm. Two Bagarisas die in the fight, and the others revive them. Harry uses the Bagarisas' exploding forward power.
316169bc2b0f.t: Harry dan para Bagarisa mulai saling memahami ritme. Dua Bagarisa mati dalam pertarungan, dan yang lain menghidupkan mereka kembali. Harry memakai kekuatan ledakan maju para Bagarisa.

31d0409cc6f6.en: "Hey, Nefi, is everything all right?" Neferteri stands and hugs her husband. "Of course it is. You're here with me."
31d0409cc6f6.t: "Hei, Nefi, semuanya baik-baik saja?" Neferteri berdiri dan memeluk suaminya. "Tentu saja. Kamu ada di sini bersamaku."

320be71e1494.en: Huneo buys their answers in the end, but still won't raise the reward for Harry, and demands control of the budget. Neferteri agrees, to push the idea that she isn't so closely tied to Harry; Itagiba goes along; Eiri refuses, but she's outvoted. She holds back her emotions and moves on to the next topic.
320be71e1494.t: Huneo akhirnya menerima jawaban mereka, tapi tetap tak mau menaikkan imbalan untuk Harry, dan menuntut kendali atas anggaran. Neferteri setuju, untuk mendorong kesan bahwa ia tidak begitu terkait dengan Harry; Itagiba ikut; Eiri menolak, tapi kalah suara. Ia menahan emosinya dan beralih ke topik berikutnya.

3228314ad3fc.en: Wide-eyed, Eiri has listened to everything; Sora is asleep against Aurora. "I just can't believe it. I want to, but I don't. Hmmmm. It does explain why Neferteri was so willing to call a search quest for Harry, and even to have me get him to sign the contract. She loves Eori the most, after all." Eiri spills everything she knows.
3228314ad3fc.t: Dengan mata terbelalak, Eiri mendengarkan semuanya; Sora tertidur bersandar pada Aurora. "Aku tidak percaya. Aku ingin percaya, tapi tidak. Hmmmm. Ini memang menjelaskan kenapa Neferteri begitu mau memasang misi pencarian untuk Harry, bahkan menyuruhku membuatnya menandatangani kontrak itu. Bagaimanapun, dia paling menyayangi Eori." Eiri menumpahkan semua yang ia tahu.

3245f3c01910.en: "You don't look like someone who wants to die, but I can tell you already have." Clodoveu sets his weapon aside and sits. "Want to know what a Hifuna beast is? Go near Hifuna, and you'll see all kinds of strange beasts. Most are animals we eat, turned into monsters from living out there. A friend of mine went to loot dead adventurers and never came back. But you—I don't think you're a Hifuna beast. Did you sell yourself to a scientist?"
3245f3c01910.t: "Kamu tidak terlihat seperti orang yang ingin mati, tapi aku bisa melihat kamu sudah pernah mati." Clodoveu menaruh senjatanya dan duduk. "Mau tahu apa itu makhluk buas Hifuna? Pergilah dekat Hifuna, dan kamu akan melihat segala macam makhluk buas yang aneh. Kebanyakan hewan yang biasa kita makan, berubah menjadi monster karena hidup di sana. Seorang temanku pergi menjarah petualang yang mati dan tak pernah kembali. Tapi kamu—kurasa kamu bukan makhluk buas Hifuna. Apa kamu menjual dirimu kepada seorang ilmuwan?"

32bece148f77.en: He screams, tackles a Wozen from behind, and his hand lights up, burning it alive; he kills it by burning its face and mouth.
32bece148f77.t: Ia menjerit, menerjang seekor Wozen dari belakang, dan tangannya menyala, membakarnya hidup-hidup; ia membunuhnya dengan membakar wajah dan mulutnya.

33ff0bcdf78e.en: Katsuki pulls away and starts walking back. Katsumi grabs her. "Too late now! Harry's dead meat! He's not gonna survive the night."
33ff0bcdf78e.t: Katsuki melepaskan diri dan mulai berjalan kembali. Katsumi mencengkeramnya. "Sudah terlambat! Harry sudah tamat! Dia tak akan selamat malam ini."

35cdee85b8e7.en: "I am the Queen of Sanbi, but above all, I'm the mother of four princesses. I trusted you with an important task despite my doubts about your ability to care for others. But your inability to control your emotions turned out just as unacceptable as Maiara's… and Yacamim's." They stare each other down, until Neferteri closes her eyes. "Princess Nina, please come in."
35cdee85b8e7.t: "Aku Ratu Sanbi, tapi di atas segalanya, aku ibu dari empat putri. Aku memercayakan tugas penting kepadamu meski aku ragu akan kemampuanmu memedulikan orang lain. Tapi ketidakmampuanmu mengendalikan emosi ternyata sama tak bisa diterimanya dengan Maiara… dan Yacamim." Mereka saling menatap, sampai Neferteri memejamkan mata. "Putri Nina, silakan masuk."

3710de2bbc7e.en: Aurora slowly backs away. "OH NO! You come back here!" "I'm sorry, Princess, but I'm not sure what to say about this." "What? It's dead simple! I asked for Harry! He's mine!" "Asked?" Eori: "No! He's mine! You won the battle, which means you lost Harry!" "But that doesn't mean he's yours!"
3710de2bbc7e.t: Aurora perlahan mundur. "OH TIDAK! Kamu kembali ke sini!" "Maaf, Putri, tapi saya tidak yakin harus bilang apa soal ini." "Apa? Ini sederhana sekali! Aku yang meminta Harry! Dia milikku!" "Meminta?" Eori: "Tidak! Dia milikku! Kamu memenangkan pertarungan, yang berarti kamu kehilangan Harry!" "Tapi itu tidak berarti dia milikmu!"

3796a9873bf6.en: Marcus: "We're close to Forkpoint." Clodoveu pulls the wagon over. "Let's put on fake bodies. Harry, you ready?" "I guess so." Clodoveu hands him a nari gel bottle with Bagarisa fur, eyes and more in it. Harry gulps. Marcus: "I'm gonna force it down your throat if you don't." Clodoveu: "Give him some time. Some people aren't good at swallowing." Marcus narrows his eyes, but says nothing.
3796a9873bf6.t: Marcus: "Kita sudah dekat Forkpoint." Clodoveu menepikan gerobak. "Ayo pakai tubuh palsu. Harry, siap?" "Kurasa begitu." Clodoveu memberinya botol nari gel berisi bulu, mata, dan bagian lain Bagarisa. Harry menelan ludah. Marcus: "Akan kujejalkan ke tenggorokanmu kalau kamu tidak mau." Clodoveu: "Beri dia waktu. Sebagian orang tidak pandai menelan." Marcus menyipitkan mata, tapi tak berkata apa-apa.

37f46f8e27b2.en: This new life isn't so bad, he thinks: he's free to do anything, and nobody hurts him. Something bites, but he doesn't set the hook, and the bait is stolen. He slaps on a new chunk of meat and casts as hard as he can.
37f46f8e27b2.t: Hidup baru ini tidak terlalu buruk, pikirnya: ia bebas melakukan apa saja, dan tak ada yang menyakitinya. Ada yang menyambar, tapi ia tidak menyentak kailnya, dan umpannya dicuri. Ia memasang sepotong daging baru dan melempar sekuat tenaga.

38c40032b71e.en: A Darfaries bandit girl steps out of the shadows
38c40032b71e.t: Seorang gadis bandit Darfaries keluar dari bayang-bayang

38f26614b47a.en: Sora gets flustered and looks away in shame. Eiri: "Nobody told you?" "About what?" Eiri waves her in to close the door. Eori does, but doesn't sit; she stands a few feet away, glaring at them both.
38f26614b47a.t: Sora gugup dan membuang muka karena malu. Eiri: "Tidak ada yang memberitahumu?" "Soal apa?" Eiri melambaikan tangan menyuruhnya masuk dan menutup pintu. Eori melakukannya, tapi tidak duduk; ia berdiri beberapa langkah jauhnya, menatap tajam mereka berdua.

39fb564ac7c0.en: Neferteri tells Nina that Eori has been behaving badly, and she needs all the support she can get. Nina says she'll help, then asks why they're hiding behind nari gel.
39fb564ac7c0.t: Neferteri memberi tahu Nina bahwa Eori berkelakuan buruk, dan ia butuh semua dukungan yang bisa ia dapat. Nina bilang ia akan membantu, lalu bertanya kenapa mereka bersembunyi di balik nari gel.

3a22d7c05f81.en: Katsumi, in the bandit's clothes, in a small cave with a fost lamp
3a22d7c05f81.t: Katsumi, berpakaian baju si bandit, di gua kecil dengan lampu fost

3a5258ba48e9.en: In a few blinks, a red sea of blood pools around the bandit, and his life flashes away. Katsumi gets up and spits in his face. "See? I told ya it was something special."
3a5258ba48e9.t: Dalam beberapa kedipan, lautan darah merah menggenang di sekitar si bandit, dan nyawanya melayang. Katsumi bangun dan meludahi wajahnya. "Lihat? Sudah kubilang ini sesuatu yang spesial."

3b561f9b8119.en: "Maiara learned her lesson. I still think Eori should live and learn. There's a reason we have Forway laws." "Let me handle her. She'll be a shining example." "All right. If you feel that strongly about it, have it your way. Just cut them some slack once in a while."
3b561f9b8119.t: "Maiara sudah belajar dari kesalahannya. Aku tetap berpikir Eori harus hidup dan belajar. Ada alasannya kita punya hukum Forway." "Biar aku yang menanganinya. Dia akan menjadi teladan yang cemerlang." "Baiklah. Kalau kamu sangat yakin soal itu, lakukan dengan caramu. Hanya, sesekali beri mereka kelonggaran."

3b9be63a2329.en: Harry and the Bagarisas settle in to sleep, full
3b9be63a2329.t: Harry dan para Bagarisa bersiap tidur, kenyang

3beb9f166d2e.en: Memories of Katsumi and Katsuki, of Eori and everyone else. Another bite: he sets the hook and pulls in a fish, and the Bagarisas oink like crazy. He cooks the fish in his hands, pulls it apart and tosses it to them, and they go crazy slurping it up.
3beb9f166d2e.t: Kenangan tentang Katsumi dan Katsuki, tentang Eori dan semua yang lain. Sambaran lagi: ia menyentak kailnya dan menarik seekor ikan, dan para Bagarisa menguik seperti orang gila. Ia memasak ikan itu di tangannya, mencabik-cabiknya dan melemparkannya kepada mereka, dan mereka melahapnya dengan heboh.

3c57dec66244.en: Something drops behind him, squeezes him tight and lifts him off the ground, sniffing him deeply, like a fat guy with a fried chicken he just bought. The breath tickles his neck and he laughs. "You're just like Desmond!" says a familiar voice in his ear, her bristly fur rubbing him and making him laugh even harder.
3c57dec66244.t: Sesuatu jatuh di belakangnya, mendekapnya erat dan mengangkatnya dari tanah, mengendusnya dalam-dalam, seperti pria gendut dengan ayam goreng yang baru dibelinya. Napasnya menggelitik leher Harry dan ia tertawa. "Kamu persis seperti Desmond!" kata suara yang familier di telinganya, bulunya yang kasar menggesek Harry dan membuatnya tertawa makin keras.

402275734e6f.en: He walks toward Harry, who watches him warily, readies a fireball and launches it. Clodoveu shifts his belly aside and raises his arm; the ball flies past, burning his skin, and explodes in the distance, searing his back and hair. His wounds stop healing. He touches his hair. "I'm all out of healing now. Dammit. Well, you asked for it!"
402275734e6f.t: Ia berjalan ke arah Harry, yang mengawasinya dengan waspada, menyiapkan bola api dan melontarkannya. Clodoveu menggeser perutnya ke samping dan mengangkat lengannya; bola itu melesat lewat, membakar kulitnya, dan meledak di kejauhan, menghanguskan punggung dan rambutnya. Luka-lukanya berhenti sembuh. Ia menyentuh rambutnya. "Penyembuhanku sudah habis. Sialan. Yah, kamu yang minta!"

418857ecb413.en: Neferteri and Nina, back at Sanbi Castle
418857ecb413.t: Neferteri dan Nina, kembali di Kastil Sanbi

426cfe102cdc.en: He watches the sun rise over the forest, but his mind drifts to everyone he has betrayed: he broke his promise to Eiri, he let the Bagarisas die, and now he's about to steal from someone. His heart squeezes. Is this what I really want? But what else can I do? I don't know anyone!
426cfe102cdc.t: Ia menyaksikan matahari terbit di atas hutan, tapi pikirannya melayang ke semua orang yang telah ia khianati: ia mengingkari janjinya kepada Eiri, ia membiarkan para Bagarisa mati, dan kini ia hendak mencuri dari seseorang. Hatinya terasa diremas. Apa ini yang benar-benar kuinginkan? Tapi apa lagi yang bisa kulakukan? Aku tidak kenal siapa pun!

43195101199d.en: Hiromi laughs it off. "My bad, I guess. I just remember her being innocent. I haven't really talked to her in years." "If you laid off the booze every time we went to the castle, you'd probably remember something, you fat cunt." "You're drinking too, cut the crap." "Fuck you! You're the one emptying our home stockpile!" "Fuck that! Fuck you!" He stands and pumps his arm, calling her out for a throwdown.
43195101199d.t: Hiromi tertawa saja. "Salahku, mungkin. Aku cuma ingat dia polos. Aku sudah bertahun-tahun tidak benar-benar bicara dengannya." "Kalau kamu berhenti mabuk setiap kali kita ke kastil, mungkin kamu ingat sesuatu, dasar gendut sialan." "Kamu juga minum, jangan omong kosong." "Persetan denganmu! Kamu yang menghabiskan persediaan rumah kita!" "Persetan! Persetan kamu!" Ia berdiri dan mengayunkan lengannya, menantangnya berkelahi.

4358649ccd5d.en: Out of pure spite, Eori injects herself with nari, catching Huneo and his guard off guard. She attacks the guard, who can barely defend himself and tells Huneo to run. He doesn't. Eori sends the guard flying, incapacitating him.
4358649ccd5d.t: Karena dendam semata, Eori menyuntikkan nari ke dirinya, mengejutkan Huneo dan penjaganya. Ia menyerang penjaga itu, yang nyaris tak bisa membela diri dan menyuruh Huneo lari. Huneo tidak lari. Eori membuat penjaga itu terpental, melumpuhkannya.

435e94827567.en: A Bagarisa heals Harry, and he cuddles it. "Thank you! I love you guys!" Happy oinks. Then he gets sad again: he's still stuck in the forest.
435e94827567.t: Seekor Bagarisa menyembuhkan Harry, dan ia memeluknya. "Terima kasih! Aku sayang kalian!" Kuikan gembira. Lalu ia sedih lagi: ia masih terjebak di hutan.

43b3ba3d6b24.en: Wozen fur covers her skin and eyes. Wilson props himself in the hallway doorway, hands on his stomach. "Great timing, Wilson. Come in and have a seat," says the half-woman, half-Wozen. Marcus: "So what's the plan?" "Slow down. First, how's your belly feeling?" The smirk between her sharp teeth entrances Harry: he has never seen anything like it.
43b3ba3d6b24.t: Bulu Wozen menutupi kulit dan matanya. Wilson bersandar di ambang pintu lorong, tangan di perutnya. "Waktu yang tepat, Wilson. Masuk dan duduklah," kata si setengah wanita, setengah Wozen. Marcus: "Jadi apa rencananya?" "Pelan-pelan. Pertama, bagaimana perutmu?" Seringai di antara gigi-giginya yang tajam memukau Harry: ia belum pernah melihat yang seperti itu.

449c3ce8c116.en: If enough people ever harass Deo into finishing the story, these notes are the base, changed only as much as needed to keep everything lore-accurate. Most of this was written before Arc 1's notes were fully expanded into the published books, so Vols 1 to 4 are the lore-accurate version wherever they conflict. There's a lot to keep track of, almost as if someone decided to challenge themselves a bit too much, for fun…
449c3ce8c116.t: Kalau suatu saat cukup banyak orang merongrong Deo agar menyelesaikan ceritanya, catatan-catatan ini adalah dasarnya, diubah hanya sebanyak yang perlu agar semuanya sesuai lore. Sebagian besar ditulis sebelum catatan Arc 1 sepenuhnya dikembangkan menjadi buku-buku yang terbit, jadi Jilid 1 sampai 4 adalah versi yang sesuai lore di mana pun keduanya bertentangan. Banyak sekali yang harus dicatat, nyaris seolah seseorang memutuskan menantang dirinya sendiri agak berlebihan, demi kesenangan…

465ddca95f0d.en: Harry takes a deep breath and eats the jelly in gulps. His body splits open in a fissure as blood and a white soul flame pour out. He screams in pain as his voice drops, hoarse, Bagarisa-like; tusks grow from his face, and one of his arms swells. Marcus grabs his knives. "What the fuck?" Harry lets out a massive shriek that makes the forest tremble in fear. Marcus throws a knife right into its forehead. It looks at Marcus with hanger in its eyes.
465ddca95f0d.t: Harry menarik napas dalam-dalam dan menelan jeli itu bertegukan. Tubuhnya merekah terbuka seperti celah saat darah dan api jiwa putih mengalir keluar. Ia menjerit kesakitan saat suaranya turun, serak, seperti Bagarisa; taring tumbuh dari wajahnya, dan salah satu lengannya membengkak. Marcus meraih pisau-pisaunya. "Apa-apaan?" Harry mengeluarkan pekikan dahsyat yang membuat hutan gemetar ketakutan. Marcus melempar pisau tepat ke dahinya. Makhluk itu menatap Marcus dengan rasa lapar bercampur amarah di matanya.

471d6b5f96bb.en: The others, a female among them, cast a spell at the foliage to curse the fruit down. One crashes onto Harry's hand and lands by his groin. Remembering the last fruit, he watches the Bagarisas eat first, only the white inside, then follows suit, and almost cums from how good it is. Together, they strip the tree bare.
471d6b5f96bb.t: Yang lain, termasuk seekor betina, merapal mantra ke dedaunan untuk menjatuhkan buahnya. Satu buah menimpa tangan Harry dan mendarat di dekat selangkangannya. Teringat buah sebelumnya, ia mengawasi para Bagarisa makan lebih dulu, hanya bagian dalam yang putih, lalu ikut makan, dan nyaris crot saking enaknya. Bersama-sama, mereka melucuti pohon itu sampai habis.

477bcd023dc3.en: Ryo spots a girl stumbling through the forest like a zombie, in the afternoon
477bcd023dc3.t: Ryo melihat seorang gadis terhuyung-huyung menembus hutan seperti zombi, di sore hari

4861c77d3242.en: They talk it over, and the adventurer helps with gravity control. Katsumi pulls out her sister Katsuki's body, and they leave. Ryo tries to grab some stuff, but the adventurer refuses: that's too much. Ryo says fine, and they head off to Forway.
4861c77d3242.t: Mereka membicarakannya, dan si petualang membantu dengan pengendalian gravitasi. Katsumi mengeluarkan jasad saudarinya, Katsuki, dan mereka pergi. Ryo mencoba mengambil beberapa barang, tapi si petualang menolak: itu keterlaluan. Ryo bilang baiklah, dan mereka berangkat ke Forway.

48812a79a289.en: "All right, I'll tell you more if you give me a massage." Clodoveu winks. Harry raises his hands in defense, his brain playing a short horror movie of him touching Clodoveu's body. Marcus, under his breath: "Buttfuckers."
48812a79a289.t: "Baiklah, aku akan cerita lebih banyak kalau kamu memijatku." Clodoveu mengedipkan mata. Harry mengangkat tangan membela diri, otaknya memutar film horor pendek tentang dirinya menyentuh tubuh Clodoveu. Marcus, setengah berbisik: "Tukang sodomi."

489631504e5b.en: Harry #8-C after dinner, late at night, around the campfire
489631504e5b.t: Harry #8-C setelah makan malam, larut malam, di sekitar api unggun

48ac0bf31fc3.en: Eiri goes on the defensive. "But this is for the better! We lost Arukia!" Silence; Sora peeks out of the pillow with teary eyes, then hides again. "I thought you always told me everything! Sora! I don't want to hurt you! Or you two! Why didn't anybody say anything?" Itanema: "Because you only ever believe Sora anyway."
48ac0bf31fc3.t: Eiri menjadi defensif. "Tapi ini demi kebaikan! Kita sudah kehilangan Arukia!" Hening; Sora mengintip dari balik bantal dengan mata berkaca-kaca, lalu bersembunyi lagi. "Kukira kamu selalu memberitahuku segalanya! Sora! Aku tidak mau menyakitimu! Atau kalian berdua! Kenapa tidak ada yang bilang apa-apa?" Itanema: "Karena kamu cuma pernah percaya pada Sora."

48b958ea76a3.en: The sisters and the Black Magina man
48b958ea76a3.t: Kedua saudari itu dan pria Black Magina

4925b3d4992f.en: Clodoveu: "So yeah. We were on our own for at least 5 to 7 years before the Blue Wozens poached us." Harry: "So how did you guys meet?" Clodoveu tells their backstory: all three are from Big-Gyut, in the Freeish Kingdom, and they started out young and dumb, a mix of peer pressure, rebellion and immaturity. Wilson laughs. Marcus stands up, faces away from the wagon and pees off the road. Clodoveu keeps going.
4925b3d4992f.t: Clodoveu: "Jadi ya. Kami bergerak sendiri setidaknya 5 sampai 7 tahun sebelum Blue Wozens merekrut kami." Harry: "Jadi bagaimana kalian bertemu?" Clodoveu menceritakan kisah masa lalu mereka: ketiganya dari Big-Gyut, di Kerajaan Freeish, dan mereka memulai sebagai anak muda yang bodoh, campuran tekanan teman, pemberontakan, dan ketidakdewasaan. Wilson tertawa. Marcus berdiri, membelakangi gerobak, dan kencing di pinggir jalan. Clodoveu melanjutkan.

499f919a471c.en: Chapter 5 - Friends With A Handful of Benefits.

49e601fa696d.en: They raise their glasses; Harry follows, unsure. "Is she like me?" "{WIP-wozenLady}? Nah. She always wears that nari gel, and she can't use the Wozen interface, though she really wants to." "Really?" Harry lights his hand on fire at will. "I wish I could use the Darfaries interface."
49e601fa696d.t: Mereka mengangkat gelas; Harry ikut, ragu. "Apa dia seperti aku?" "{WIP-wozenLady}? Bukan. Dia selalu memakai nari gel itu, dan dia tak bisa memakai antarmuka Wozen, meski dia sangat ingin." "Sungguh?" Harry menyalakan tangannya sesuka hati. "Andai aku bisa memakai antarmuka Darfaries."

4a254e7cf1e4.en: Katsumi wakes up, pushes herself away from Ryo and takes off running. "KATSUMI!" She stops, comes back and goes to punch him in the face, but his adventurer guard, {WIP-rioAdventGuard}, stops her, and she falls to the ground. Ryo: "Hey, {WIP-rioAdventGuard}! No need to get aggressive." The adventurer doesn't reply.
4a254e7cf1e4.t: Katsumi terbangun, mendorong dirinya menjauh dari Ryo, dan lari. "KATSUMI!" Ia berhenti, kembali, dan hendak meninju wajahnya, tapi penjaga petualangnya, {WIP-rioAdventGuard}, menghentikannya, dan ia jatuh ke tanah. Ryo: "Hei, {WIP-rioAdventGuard}! Tidak perlu agresif." Si petualang tidak menjawab.

4b19a3a02779.en: Harry goes quiet, thinking of the Bagarisas. "Thinking about them won't bring them back." "But can't I bring them back?" Clodoveu shakes his head. "Reviving animals is a crapshoot, like babies and old people. Worse, Marcus cooked the meat, and you can't revive something that's been cooked. He did it on purpose." Harry seethes. "Please don't light up right now. If you want to bash Marcus's face in, just challenge him to a duel. I bet he'll accept, no problem." Harry takes a deep breath.
4b19a3a02779.t: Harry terdiam, memikirkan para Bagarisa. "Memikirkan mereka tidak akan mengembalikan mereka." "Tapi tidak bisakah aku menghidupkan mereka kembali?" Clodoveu menggeleng. "Menghidupkan kembali hewan itu untung-untungan, seperti bayi dan orang tua. Lebih buruk lagi, Marcus memasak dagingnya, dan kamu tak bisa menghidupkan kembali sesuatu yang sudah dimasak. Dia sengaja." Harry mendidih. "Tolong jangan menyala sekarang. Kalau kamu mau menghajar muka Marcus, tantang saja dia berduel. Aku yakin dia akan menerimanya, tanpa masalah." Harry menarik napas dalam-dalam.

4b3372ccda05.en: Clodoveu: "See, Wilson? That's why Marcus doesn't have any friends." "For real, what an asshole—" Something clicks in Wilson's head. "Hey! Don't use my real name! I'm not wearing a fake skin!" "It's fine. By the way, Harry, I'm Clodoveu. Sorry about the Bagarisas, but Marcus is still pissed about what you did."
4b3372ccda05.t: Clodoveu: "Lihat, Wilson? Itulah sebabnya Marcus tidak punya teman." "Serius, bajingan sekali—" Sesuatu tersambung di kepala Wilson. "Hei! Jangan pakai nama asliku! Aku tidak sedang memakai kulit palsu!" "Tidak apa-apa. Ngomong-ngomong, Harry, aku Clodoveu. Maaf soal Bagarisa-nya, tapi Marcus masih kesal dengan apa yang kamu lakukan."

4b9548e556d6.en: Clodoveu turns back to Harry. "So what tickles your brain? You know, what type of girl, or boy, makes you want to fuck them up, or get fucked all night?" Images of the girls he's been with pass through Harry's head, but one stands out. "There was this girl called Sora, a Sanbi maid. She was pretty cute." "What type? Wozefaries, human? Personality? Give me descriptions!" Harry describes Sora in a glowing light, then tells him about the trap Itagiba set for him.
4b9548e556d6.t: Clodoveu berbalik ke Harry lagi. "Jadi apa yang menggelitik otakmu? Kamu tahu, tipe cewek, atau cowok, yang membuatmu ingin mengentot mereka habis-habisan, atau dientot semalaman?" Bayangan gadis-gadis yang pernah bersamanya melintas di kepala Harry, tapi satu menonjol. "Ada gadis bernama Sora, pelayan Sanbi. Dia cukup imut." "Tipe apa? Wozefaries, manusia? Kepribadiannya? Beri aku gambaran!" Harry menggambarkan Sora dengan penuh kekaguman, lalu menceritakan jebakan yang dipasang Itagiba untuknya.

4be4a76a2311.en: They throw spells and everything else they can, but that only feeds the fire; they have no idea what the fuck they're doing. They watch the Bagarisa body slowly take shape from the goo. Suddenly, a fire roars with a light so bright that even with your eyes closed it feels like staring at the sun.
4be4a76a2311.t: Mereka melempar mantra dan segala hal lain yang bisa mereka lempar, tapi itu hanya memberi makan apinya; mereka sama sekali tak tahu apa yang sedang mereka lakukan, sialan. Mereka menyaksikan tubuh Bagarisa itu perlahan terbentuk dari lendir. Tiba-tiba, api menderu dengan cahaya begitu terang sampai bahkan dengan mata terpejam rasanya seperti menatap matahari.

4c37e7e2e23a.en: Chapter 3 - Sanbi’s Second Courtroom Scientist Apprentice
4c37e7e2e23a.t: Bab 3 - Murid Ilmuwan Istana Kedua Sanbi

4cf815480f5e.en: "Bringing supplies to the old lady guarding the loot house, but she must have died a few weeks ago, after her fost stone lamp got too small." Wilson: "I smelled her clothes, then searched for her, but all I found was some blood and scraps of torn clothes. A Fatupari must've gotten her." "That's why we now have to bring all the goods back to the den. Someone's next quest—" Marcus: "You fat pussies gonna talk all day? Fucking cuntholes! Step it up!" Clodoveu ignores him. "—will be finding a new den."
4cf815480f5e.t: "Membawa perbekalan untuk wanita tua yang menjaga rumah jarahan, tapi dia pasti sudah mati beberapa minggu lalu, setelah lampu batu fost-nya jadi terlalu kecil." Wilson: "Aku mencium pakaiannya, lalu mencarinya, tapi yang kutemukan hanya sedikit darah dan sobekan pakaian. Pasti dimakan Fatupari." "Itulah sebabnya sekarang kita harus membawa semua barang kembali ke markas. Misi seseorang berikutnya—" Marcus: "Kalian pengecut gendut mau ngobrol seharian? Lubang memek sialan! Percepat langkah!" Clodoveu mengabaikannya. "—adalah mencari markas baru."

4d582501068a.en: Wilson splashes a torrent of Cold Water on Harry. His flames flicker in and out, then the white soul flame covering his body grows stronger. The flame swells, weaves, then explodes in a curtain of fire.
4d582501068a.t: Wilson menyiramkan semburan Cold Water ke Harry. Apinya berkedip-kedip, lalu api jiwa putih yang menyelimuti tubuhnya makin kuat. Api itu membengkak, meliuk, lalu meledak menjadi tirai api.

4ee6b448af64.en: Harry shrieks and rushes Clodoveu with his smaller fist. Clodoveu stops it with his hand, bone cracking all around, punches Harry's gut with the other, then steps back, dodging the big hand, now nearly regrown. He shakes out his hand. "Not even a dent."
4ee6b448af64.t: Harry memekik dan menerjang Clodoveu dengan tinjunya yang lebih kecil. Clodoveu menahannya dengan tangannya, tulang retak di mana-mana, meninju perut Harry dengan tangan lainnya, lalu mundur, menghindari tangan besar yang kini nyaris tumbuh kembali. Ia mengibaskan tangannya. "Lecet pun tidak."

4ef1403868e3.en: He shades his eyes at the sun. "Hmmm! I guess I'll get there by early night." A Bagarisa oinks, bobbing its head at a tree. "Oh! You guys want some of that? Sure!" He brings the fruit down with his power; the Bagarisas go to town, and he cracks one open too. He remembers fleeing the wagon and eating the fruit that made him puke his guts out, and laughs. Yeah. That sucked.
4ef1403868e3.t: Ia melindungi matanya dari matahari. "Hmmm! Kurasa aku akan sampai di sana saat malam baru mulai." Seekor Bagarisa menguik, mengangguk-anggukkan kepala ke arah sebuah pohon. "Oh! Kalian mau itu? Tentu!" Ia menjatuhkan buahnya dengan kekuatannya; para Bagarisa melahapnya habis-habisan, dan ia juga membelah satu. Ia teringat kabur dari gerobak dan memakan buah yang membuatnya muntah habis-habisan, dan tertawa. Ya. Itu payah.

4f2591c0a234.en: Dinner: Clodoveu, Marcus (eating alone, pissed), Wilson and Harry
4f2591c0a234.t: Makan malam: Clodoveu, Marcus (makan sendirian, kesal), Wilson, dan Harry

4f55de3244cb.en: Kozaku: "Speak." Clodoveu: "Boss, {WIP-oldHagLootHouse} was eaten by wild animals." Kozaku stands; a flame rises from his heart and runs down his arm along his Darfaries line. His firm steps echo through the big, damp room.
4f55de3244cb.t: Kozaku: "Bicara." Clodoveu: "Bos, {WIP-oldHagLootHouse} dimakan hewan liar." Kozaku berdiri; api muncul dari jantungnya dan mengalir turun ke lengannya sepanjang garis Darfaries-nya. Langkahnya yang mantap menggema di ruangan besar yang lembap itu.

507d2d052d81.en: One of them steps forward. "We want you to retire." "Sure. How do I do that?"
507d2d052d81.t: Salah satu dari mereka maju. "Kami ingin Anda pensiun." "Boleh. Bagaimana caranya?"

50957cb33ab5.en: Wilson laughs. "I saw that one coming!" Clodoveu gives him a thumbs-up. "That'll teach him something new." Harry's body gasps, and he slowly gets up, head pounding as it finishes healing. Clodoveu hugs him from the side. "Anything's a weapon if you time it right. Sorry for throwing so hard. Let's call it a day and head back to the den?" Harry nods.
50957cb33ab5.t: Wilson tertawa. "Sudah kuduga itu!" Clodoveu mengacungkan jempol kepadanya. "Itu akan mengajarinya sesuatu yang baru." Tubuh Harry tersentak menarik napas, dan ia perlahan bangun, kepalanya berdenyut saat penyembuhannya selesai. Clodoveu memeluknya dari samping. "Apa saja bisa jadi senjata kalau waktunya tepat. Maaf melempar terlalu keras. Kita sudahi hari ini dan kembali ke markas?" Harry mengangguk.

518ccb06c927.en: "Princesses! Please!" Both stare at Aurora so hard she feels she might crumble. "Princess Maiara, how did you ask for Harry?" The princesses glance at each other, as if suddenly realizing something. Eori crosses her arms. "Maiara asked for a husband who could match her in combat, and Gabiro found someone from the outskirts who apparently had great innate power."
518ccb06c927.t: "Para Putri! Tolong!" Keduanya menatap Aurora begitu tajam sampai ia merasa bisa runtuh. "Putri Maiara, bagaimana Anda meminta Harry?" Kedua putri saling melirik, seolah tiba-tiba menyadari sesuatu. Eori menyilangkan lengan. "Maiara meminta suami yang bisa mengimbanginya dalam pertarungan, dan Gabiro menemukan seseorang dari pinggiran yang rupanya punya kekuatan bawaan yang besar."

519dc8f095cb.en: From here, Takeo hunts down the clandestine Magina plantation, doing his own thing, until he comes across Harry and gets interested in his peculiar vibes.
519dc8f095cb.t: Dari sini, Takeo memburu perkebunan Magina gelap itu, melakukan urusannya sendiri, sampai ia menemukan Harry dan tertarik pada auranya yang aneh.

52239424c0bb.en: Hand on his stomach, he finds a fruit that looks too delicious to be true, and eats his fill. He feels amazing, like never before.
52239424c0bb.t: Tangan di perutnya, ia menemukan buah yang tampak terlalu lezat untuk jadi kenyataan, dan makan sampai kenyang. Ia merasa luar biasa, seperti belum pernah sebelumnya.

52341a106e6d.en: He manages to hobble onto his belly, but his arms and legs move on their own; he tastes sweet, then sour, then bitter. He hears Clodoveu, he hears Harry's screams; he sees everything, hears everything.
52341a106e6d.t: Ia berhasil tertatih berbaring tengkurap, tapi lengan dan kakinya bergerak sendiri; ia merasakan manis, lalu asam, lalu pahit. Ia mendengar Clodoveu, ia mendengar jeritan Harry; ia melihat segalanya, mendengar segalanya.

52f01bf7e826.en: The Wozen lady: "Your team will raid Maicon's warehouse in Forkpoint, then take the loot by boat to Old Village. There, you split up: one side takes the loot north to Fiera's hut, the other follows the river to Minala. Then you switch to a wagon, pass through Rebula, and burn the wagon."
52f01bf7e826.t: Si wanita Wozen: "Tim kalian akan menyerbu gudang Maicon di Forkpoint, lalu membawa jarahannya dengan perahu ke Old Village. Di sana, kalian berpencar: satu pihak membawa jarahan ke utara ke pondok Fiera, yang lain mengikuti sungai ke Minala. Lalu kalian pindah ke gerobak, lewat Rebula, dan bakar gerobaknya."

534ad940ef29.en: In the distance, someone comes along in a boat pulled by an Egua. Harry retreats into the forest with the Bagarisas.
534ad940ef29.t: Di kejauhan, seseorang datang dengan perahu yang ditarik seekor Egua. Harry mundur ke hutan bersama para Bagarisa.

53a38a94d011.en: "What are you talking about? I am your sister! Listen here! I just want us to be free! Emelia, Arukia and all the other Red Winga people are full of shit!" Katsuki hangs her head and goes silent. "There's no going back now. C'mon. Let's go."
53a38a94d011.t: "Apa maksudmu? Aku saudarimu! Dengar! Aku cuma ingin kita bebas! Emelia, Arukia, dan semua orang Red Winga lainnya omong kosong!" Katsuki menundukkan kepala dan terdiam. "Tak ada jalan kembali sekarang. Ayo. Kita pergi."

544324989d1f.en: Harry #10 watches the moon, bundled in blankets, Clodoveu beside him in the house
544324989d1f.t: Harry #10 menatap bulan, terbungkus selimut, Clodoveu di sampingnya di dalam rumah

546e37dbeb11.en: Huneo and Kibe meet with Neferteri, Itagiba and Eiri
546e37dbeb11.t: Huneo dan Kibe bertemu Neferteri, Itagiba, dan Eiri

54a65770af7c.en: Huneo shakes his head. "You're missing a few steps. First, the three others need to approve a new apprentice. Second, a public hair paint must happen. Third, you need to train me up to par. Fourth, you resign publicly, and I take over the post at a public event, too. Those last two can be the same event."
54a65770af7c.t: Huneo menggeleng. "Anda melewatkan beberapa langkah. Pertama, tiga lainnya harus menyetujui murid baru. Kedua, pengecatan rambut di depan umum harus dilakukan. Ketiga, Anda harus melatih saya sampai setara. Keempat, Anda mengundurkan diri di depan umum, dan saya mengambil alih jabatan itu di acara umum juga. Dua yang terakhir bisa dalam acara yang sama."

54eea6e9b8c4.en: Harry tanks while the Bagarisas flank, and he lands the final blow, then collapses on the ground, breathing hard. "Oh wow. That was hard."
54eea6e9b8c4.t: Harry menahan serangan sementara para Bagarisa mengapit, dan ia melayangkan pukulan terakhir, lalu ambruk ke tanah, terengah-engah. "Wah. Itu berat."

550ef8a8295f.en: Chapter 4 - Something fishy, and it ain’t the docks
550ef8a8295f.t: Bab 4 - Ada yang amis, dan bukan dari dermaga

55398eb8ddb2.en: Eiri: "Adventurers are giving up on the quest, since nobody can find a hint of where Harry disappeared to." "THEN RAISE THE AMOUNT!" Eiri shakes her head. "I tried, but Huneo blocked it. In his eyes, this quest already pays too much."
55398eb8ddb2.t: Eiri: "Para petualang menyerah dengan misinya, karena tak ada yang bisa menemukan petunjuk ke mana Harry menghilang." "KALAU BEGITU NAIKKAN JUMLAHNYA!" Eiri menggeleng. "Aku sudah mencoba, tapi Huneo memblokirnya. Menurutnya, misi ini sudah dibayar terlalu mahal."

55c6586d7a35.en: He carves the animal up with a rusty knife, slaps a piece of meat skin-down in front of the Bagarisas, and takes a big piece with him.
55c6586d7a35.t: Ia memotong-motong hewan itu dengan pisau berkarat, menaruh sepotong daging dengan kulit menghadap ke bawah di depan para Bagarisa, dan membawa potongan besar bersamanya.

56e40339dc86.en: The sisters forced to work a Magina field
56e40339dc86.t: Kedua saudari itu dipaksa bekerja di ladang Magina

57987c42abd2.en: She slowly works her way through the field. The sun and the smell of Magina annoy her to no end. Sweat drips off her chin as she looks up at the distant forest. This time it'll work.
57987c42abd2.t: Ia perlahan menyusuri ladang. Matahari dan bau Magina membuatnya jengkel bukan main. Keringat menetes dari dagunya saat ia menatap hutan di kejauhan. Kali ini pasti berhasil.

580e794bec15.en: She seems to get away with it, and she learns a whole lot from trying. "Boss doesn't need to know about the fun times we're having."
580e794bec15.t: Tampaknya ia lolos begitu saja, dan ia belajar banyak sekali dari upayanya. "Bos tidak perlu tahu soal kesenangan yang kita nikmati."

5841a2adf362.en: "But of course! I plan to give you and her things other than a daily dose of my genes." The lewd smile returns. "But if that's all you want, I'll gladly provide." Katsumi: "If you save my sister, I'll show you everything I learned from the Red Winga." "Everything?" She leans in close. "E—ve—ry—thing," she says in a sensual voice.
5841a2adf362.t: "Tentu saja! Aku berencana memberimu dan dia hal-hal selain dosis harian genku." Senyum cabul itu kembali. "Tapi kalau cuma itu yang kamu mau, dengan senang hati akan kuberikan." Katsumi: "Kalau kamu menyelamatkan saudariku, akan kutunjukkan semua yang kupelajari dari Red Winga." "Semuanya?" Ia mencondongkan badan mendekat. "Se—mu—a—nya," katanya dengan suara sensual.

5868a2e94ebc.en: Eori, on nari gel, in Huneo's office
5868a2e94ebc.t: Eori, memakai nari gel, di kantor Huneo

597ebf355ee5.en: Katsumi refuses to spill the beans and spits in the man's face; he slaps her back. Katsuki looks away from her sister, and spills them.
597ebf355ee5.t: Katsumi menolak buka mulut dan meludahi wajah pria itu; ia menamparnya balik. Katsuki memalingkan wajah dari saudarinya, dan buka mulut.

5a2c946ca840.en: Rebula: men posted with weapons and fost stones; Takeo rides up on an Egua
5a2c946ca840.t: Rebula: para pria berjaga dengan senjata dan batu fost; Takeo datang menunggang Egua

5a4c0fc04151.en: Marcus hands out Bagarisa meat on sticks, one held right in front of Harry
5a4c0fc04151.t: Marcus membagikan daging Bagarisa di tusukan, satu dipegang tepat di depan Harry

5ba435cdc97e.en: In a flash, the Bagarisas and Wozens are at each other. Harry watches the Bagarisa that healed him agonize over its death, just like he did, and anger and hatred brew inside him.
5ba435cdc97e.t: Dalam sekejap, para Bagarisa dan Wozen saling serang. Harry menyaksikan Bagarisa yang menyembuhkannya meregang nyawa, persis seperti dirinya, dan amarah serta kebencian mendidih di dalam dirinya.

5ba6cdba802f.en: She leans in and whispers slowly in his ear: "If you find out how, I'll let you do anything you want." Harry blushes; so does she. "Not like that! I meant, like—going to other teams! Even working by my side!" They both laugh. She raises her hands and pushes her belly forward; Harry knows this one, and does the same. As their bellies and hands touch, she says, "I promise." Harry smiles and nods.
5ba6cdba802f.t: Ia mencondongkan badan dan berbisik pelan di telinganya: "Kalau kamu tahu caranya, aku akan membiarkanmu melakukan apa saja yang kamu mau." Wajah Harry memerah; begitu pula wajahnya. "Bukan begitu! Maksudku, seperti—pindah ke tim lain! Bahkan bekerja di sisiku!" Mereka berdua tertawa. Ia mengangkat tangan dan menyorongkan perutnya ke depan; Harry tahu yang satu ini, dan melakukan hal yang sama. Saat perut dan tangan mereka bersentuhan, ia berkata, "Aku janji." Harry tersenyum dan mengangguk.

5c48f2276df6.en: The beast jumps back, then claws open his gut. His intestines spill out onto his skin; the throbbing pain fades, and his whole body warms up. With his last strength, Harry puts his hand on the beast and screams, or rather gurgles, as the flame takes over his fingers and flashes up his forearm before going out.
5c48f2276df6.t: Makhluk buas itu melompat mundur, lalu mencakar perutnya sampai terbuka. Ususnya tumpah ke atas kulitnya; rasa sakit yang berdenyut memudar, dan seluruh tubuhnya menghangat. Dengan sisa tenaganya, Harry menaruh tangannya pada makhluk buas itu dan menjerit, atau lebih tepatnya berdeguk, saat api menguasai jari-jarinya dan menyambar ke lengan bawahnya sebelum padam.

5cd16eb9e6a3.en: Harry pictures his friends being roasted alive, and fire surges from his hand up to his elbow. Clodoveu almost misses the transformation, but douses it with a bucket of cold water. Harry shakes violently, freezing.
5cd16eb9e6a3.t: Harry membayangkan teman-temannya dipanggang hidup-hidup, dan api menyembur dari tangannya sampai ke siku. Clodoveu nyaris melewatkan transformasi itu, tapi memadamkannya dengan seember air dingin. Harry menggigil hebat, membeku.

5d32d19f454b.en: Harry #9-A sees a ghostly human figure far off (point-of-view scene)
5d32d19f454b.t: Harry #9-A melihat sosok manusia seperti hantu di kejauhan (adegan sudut pandang)

5d6fc4ecc9e3.en: Bellies full, Harry lies on the ground looking at the stars, the fire pushing back the forest's chill.
5d6fc4ecc9e3.t: Perut kenyang, Harry berbaring di tanah menatap bintang-bintang, api menghalau dinginnya hutan.

5e11edf5318c.en: Clodoveu: "If you're trying to fuck him, I'm sorry to tell you you're not his type. He prefers Tolerideme women." She blushes. "Aww, whatever. You've got your plan. Now get out!" She leaves. Marcus, dead serious: "Is that what she fucking wanted?" "Oh! Trust me. Totally." Clodoveu rolls up the plan. "All right, homies. You know the plan. Let's get some sleep and leave in the morning." Marcus: "To some good, motherfucking, bloody money!"
5e11edf5318c.t: Clodoveu: "Kalau kamu berusaha mengentotnya, maaf harus kubilang kamu bukan tipenya. Dia lebih suka perempuan Tolerideme." Wajahnya memerah. "Aww, terserah.
