c486223c4c5f.en: Marcus sits across from Harry, eating Bagarisa jerky and provoking him. Harry, gripping his coffee, wants to bash that smirk in like nobody's business; Clodoveu watches; Wilson is oblivious, picking his nose, his mind far away.
c486223c4c5f.t: Marcus duduk di seberang Harry, memakan dendeng Bagarisa dan memancingnya. Harry, mencengkeram kopinya, ingin menghajar seringai itu habis-habisan; Clodoveu mengamati; Wilson tak sadar apa-apa, mengupil, pikirannya jauh entah di mana.

c4df6cda1c61.en: Severino is chopping wood. The forest is making all kinds of noises. He stops and listens to the wind, tosses the axe aside, and goes inside to his wife, Nailah. "Done already?" "No. The forest keeps getting spooked by something." "Bad weather coming?" He gets something to drink. "Maybe? It's the season for those storms, but the forest feels wrong."
c4df6cda1c61.t: Severino sedang membelah kayu. Hutan mengeluarkan segala macam suara. Ia berhenti dan mendengarkan angin, melempar kapaknya ke samping, dan masuk menemui istrinya, Nailah. "Sudah selesai?" "Belum. Hutan terus dikejutkan sesuatu." "Cuaca buruk akan datang?" Ia mengambil minuman. "Mungkin? Ini musimnya badai-badai itu, tapi hutannya terasa tidak beres."

c4e2bdaf4f31.en: Harry wakes up sweating, Bagarisas sleeping all over him
c4e2bdaf4f31.t: Harry bangun berkeringat, para Bagarisa tidur di sekujur tubuhnya

c5353d7c6591.en: Water flies, soaking both Marcus and Harry. "What the fuck is wrong with you, you fucking faggot?" "Marcus—" Marcus grabs a fistful of Clodoveu's chest hair. "What the fuck! Don't say my name in front of this fucker!" A punch from Clodoveu knocks out a bunch of Marcus's teeth and sends him flying across the room. Clodoveu scratches at the bald patch on his chest as the hair grows back. "Anyway."
c5353d7c6591.t: Air melayang, membasahi Marcus dan Harry. "Ada apa denganmu, dasar banci sialan?" "Marcus—" Marcus mencengkeram segenggam bulu dada Clodoveu. "Sialan! Jangan sebut namaku di depan bangsat ini!" Tinju Clodoveu merontokkan sejumlah gigi Marcus dan membuatnya terlempar ke seberang ruangan. Clodoveu menggaruk bagian dadanya yang botak saat bulunya tumbuh kembali. "Pokoknya."

c5c985c9360d.en: "Harry." "From where?" "Sanbi—Kingdom." Marcus lets go. "Sanbi my ass. You're a Hifuna beast." Wilson: "Waaaaaaattt! For real?" Harry, head throbbing: "Haaaaaa?" "Don't 'ha' me! You're lying! You two, figure this fucker out while I turn the Bagarisas on the spit. I want to know where that old fat bitch went." Marcus leaves.
c5c985c9360d.t: "Harry." "Dari mana?" "Kerajaan—Sanbi." Marcus melepaskannya. "Sanbi pantatku. Kamu makhluk buas Hifuna." Wilson: "Haaaaaaahhh! Serius?" Harry, kepalanya berdenyut: "Haaaaaa?" "Jangan 'ha' padaku! Kamu bohong! Kalian berdua, cari tahu soal bangsat ini sementara aku memutar Bagarisa di panggangan. Aku ingin tahu ke mana perginya jalang tua gendut itu." Marcus pergi.

c618419e09fc.en: Takeo and the people of Rebula reach the farm; a Bagarisa in the distance is eating Harry's body
c618419e09fc.t: Takeo dan warga Rebula tiba di ladang; seekor Bagarisa di kejauhan sedang memakan jasad Harry

c63fc0e0a84e.en: Chapter 2 - An offer hard to swallow.

c75f3ce654e1.en: She goes through his pockets: 35 Pearls, and a single Amethyst in his ball pouch. "This won't even get me through two weeks, let alone hire someone to get her! Dammit! Why did you have to give up everything? We were so close!"
c75f3ce654e1.t: Ia menggeledah saku-sakunya: 35 Pearl, dan satu Amethyst di kantong bijinya. "Ini bahkan tidak cukup untuk dua minggu, apalagi menyewa orang untuk menjemputnya! Sialan! Kenapa kamu harus menyerahkan semuanya? Kita sudah begitu dekat!"

c83eeac5a6cb.en: Harry #10 meets Kozaku, who sits silently, overseeing the bandits
c83eeac5a6cb.t: Harry #10 bertemu Kozaku, yang duduk diam, mengawasi para bandit

c8a8fb369ae0.en: The maids in Sora's dormitory room, all clean and girly
c8a8fb369ae0.t: Para pelayan di kamar asrama Sora, semuanya bersih dan feminin

cb2272b124c8.en: The sisters walk the road at sunrise, Katsumi pulling Katsuki along
cb2272b124c8.t: Kedua saudari itu menyusuri jalan saat matahari terbit, Katsumi menyeret Katsuki

cb625f670f55.en: Sticks and stones are encrusted in his soles like jewels, painful, macabre ones. Pulling one out feels like a needle through the bone, followed by a warm, pounding tickle as his accelerated healing kicks in: he laughs, cries and agonizes all at once. He cleans his feet one stone at a time, but the healing gets slower with each one.
cb625f670f55.t: Ranting dan batu menempel di telapak kakinya seperti permata, permata yang menyakitkan dan mengerikan. Mencabut satu terasa seperti jarum menembus tulang, disusul geli hangat yang berdenyut saat penyembuhannya yang dipercepat bekerja: ia tertawa, menangis, dan menderita sekaligus. Ia membersihkan kakinya satu batu demi satu batu, tapi penyembuhannya makin lambat setiap kali.

cce95e23cf1e.en: Three full beers slap onto the table. Yacamim looks doubtful, but drowns it in a large beer. Hiromi: "When did your sister get that frisky?" Yacamim spit-takes all over the table and chokes, turning heads in the bar. "You fucking cunt. Why would you put it like that?"
cce95e23cf1e.t: Tiga gelas bir penuh dihantamkan ke meja. Yacamim tampak ragu, tapi menenggelamkannya dalam segelas besar bir. Hiromi: "Sejak kapan adikmu jadi segenit itu?" Yacamim menyemburkan birnya ke seluruh meja dan tersedak, membuat orang-orang di bar menoleh. "Kamu memek sialan. Kenapa kamu harus bilang begitu?"

cd2ac07d3715.en: Harry: "The Freeish Kingdom is to the south, right?" "You got it! Wait, you've never been there either? Let's take a trip there once we get some balls from this plan. There's this taco thing you're gonna love!" Harry looks pretty interested.
cd2ac07d3715.t: Harry: "Kerajaan Freeish ada di selatan, kan?" "Betul! Tunggu, kamu juga belum pernah ke sana? Ayo jalan-jalan ke sana begitu kita dapat bola dari rencana ini. Ada taco yang pasti kamu suka!" Harry tampak cukup tertarik.

ce65d95e4ea9.en: The ghostly white figure takes off running. It's thrilling! He chases it with all his strength, cocks both arms back, then forward, and unleashes a torrent of flame that lights up the sky. His ankles give out and he falls on all fours; ahead, a faint white figure wavers like a dying light.
ce65d95e4ea9.t: Sosok putih seperti hantu itu lari. Menegangkan! Ia mengejarnya sekuat tenaga, menarik kedua lengannya ke belakang, lalu ke depan, dan melepaskan semburan api yang menerangi langit. Pergelangan kakinya menyerah dan ia jatuh merangkak; di depan, sosok putih samar bergoyang seperti cahaya yang sekarat.

cecc565a8774.en: "Harry? I love him. I want him!" "The search quest has been created." "Thank you, Mom. What will happen to the contracts I signed?" "I'll deal with them. Nina, shall we all put our disguises on and go back to the castle?" "Yeahhh!" A crying Nina joins in a group hug.
cecc565a8774.t: "Harry? Aku mencintainya. Aku menginginkannya!" "Misi pencariannya sudah dibuat." "Terima kasih, Ibu. Apa yang akan terjadi pada kontrak-kontrak yang kutandatangani?" "Akan kuurus. Nina, bagaimana kalau kita semua memakai penyamaran dan kembali ke kastil?" "Yeahhh!" Nina yang menangis ikut berpelukan bersama.

cf82e57ab0b6.en: "Good! Now, where are your experiment journals?" "It's all in my head! I don't write it down for the likes of you to steal!" "Then you'll write it all down, after the inventory." She grabs a bottle to throw, and an arrow pierces her forearm, shattering the bone. Her arm falls limp, the bone exposed; she screams in pain, agony and rage.
cf82e57ab0b6.t: "Bagus! Sekarang, di mana jurnal eksperimen Anda?" "Semuanya di kepalaku! Aku tidak menuliskannya agar orang sepertimu tidak mencurinya!" "Kalau begitu Anda akan menuliskan semuanya, setelah inventarisnya." Ia meraih sebuah botol untuk dilempar, dan sebuah anak panah menembus lengan bawahnya, menghancurkan tulangnya. Lengannya terkulai, tulangnya mencuat; ia menjerit kesakitan, menderita, dan murka.

d0aa4d97fe51.en: A bandit: "Hey, you! Stop fucking around and get to work!" She picks the flowers faster, without a word. He puts a hand on her shoulder and breathes in her ear. "What's your plan for tonight? Gonna try going out the window again? Try something new, and I'll do the same, and fuck you from behind all night long."
d0aa4d97fe51.t: Seorang bandit: "Hei, kamu! Berhenti main-main dan kerja!" Ia memetik bunga lebih cepat, tanpa sepatah kata. Pria itu menaruh tangan di bahunya dan mengembuskan napas di telinganya. "Apa rencanamu malam ini? Mau coba keluar lewat jendela lagi? Coba sesuatu yang baru, dan aku juga akan begitu, dan mengentotmu dari belakang semalaman."

d0bcb9bcb02d.en: Harry #10, jacked up, eats chicken jerky drenched in Black Honey
d0bcb9bcb02d.t: Harry #10, berotot kekar, memakan dendeng ayam yang bermandikan Black Honey

d0d4d064686d.en: A dream: a Bagarisa man fights two adventurers
d0d4d064686d.t: Mimpi: seorang pria Bagarisa melawan dua petualang

d0e0e0663a9b.en: Namia apologizes: she was so sure of her findings when she first observed Arukia. Neferteri: "I don't doubt your expertise, Namia. Arukia was simply too clever at disguising who she truly was."
d0e0e0663a9b.t: Namia meminta maaf: ia begitu yakin dengan temuannya saat pertama kali mengamati Arukia. Neferteri: "Aku tidak meragukan keahlianmu, Namia. Arukia hanya terlalu pandai menyamarkan siapa dirinya sebenarnya."

d30610f76ea8.en: "That explains it, then. I came from Deltacross. Do you guys have any food to sell? I couldn't catch anything today." "Are the animals too spooked?" "Yeah! How did you know?" "Because I saw them fleeing." "So you guys are getting ready to flee too?"
d30610f76ea8.t: "Itu menjelaskannya, kalau begitu. Aku datang dari Deltacross. Kalian punya makanan untuk dijual? Aku tidak bisa menangkap apa-apa hari ini." "Hewan-hewannya terlalu ketakutan?" "Ya! Bagaimana kamu tahu?" "Karena aku melihat mereka kabur." "Jadi kalian juga bersiap untuk kabur?"

d3b6ea1cf087.en: The books and things inside are deteriorated. The only map he finds doesn't show where he is. He sighs, spots a fishing rod, and goes to sleep.
d3b6ea1cf087.t: Buku-buku dan barang-barang di dalamnya sudah rusak. Satu-satunya peta yang ia temukan tidak menunjukkan di mana ia berada. Ia menghela napas, melihat joran pancing, dan pergi tidur.

d4201421ebfc.en: She cries, but her face won't move. A single tear falls from her eye and meets blood before dropping from the branch. Dalila passes away before the tear touches the ground. (Her parents are gone, but Dalila makes it through: the same people who pick up Harry's body find and revive her.)
d4201421ebfc.t: Ia menangis, tapi wajahnya tak mau bergerak. Setetes air mata jatuh dari matanya dan bertemu darah sebelum jatuh dari dahan. Dalila meninggal sebelum air mata itu menyentuh tanah. (Orang tuanya tiada, tapi Dalila selamat: orang-orang yang sama yang mengambil jasad Harry menemukan dan menghidupkannya kembali.)

d420da1842f5.en: Clodoveu flies at Harry fist first (like Maiara did); Harry blocks with crossed arms
d420da1842f5.t: Clodoveu menerjang Harry dengan tinju di depan (seperti yang dilakukan Maiara); Harry menangkis dengan lengan bersilang

d61215b2f387.en: Kibe: "That's it. You can all go now." The captains stand up, refusing to leave. "What? We're done with the city safety debriefing."
d61215b2f387.t: Kibe: "Sudah. Kalian semua boleh pergi." Para kapten berdiri, menolak pergi. "Apa? Kita sudah selesai dengan laporan keamanan kota."

d64c389f9ac9.en: Neferteri is playing a bit coy (cu doce, as they say in Portuguese): she senses Huneo isn't someone she can easily control. She changes her mind in Book 7, once she learns how to unleash the bull in the china shop, minimizing the damage while he gets her dirty work done without her getting her hands dirty.
d64c389f9ac9.t: Neferteri agak jual mahal (cu doce, kata orang Portugis): ia merasakan Huneo bukan orang yang bisa ia kendalikan dengan mudah. Ia berubah pikiran di Buku 7, begitu ia belajar cara melepaskan banteng di toko porselen, meminimalkan kerusakannya sementara banteng itu mengerjakan pekerjaan kotornya tanpa ia harus mengotori tangannya sendiri.

d695b8af9ba6.en: His body is nearly weightless as he pushes it to the limit; his racing thoughts analyze nearly everything in his vision and adjust his pace. He feels his bones crack, his joints bust and heal, only to burst again.
d695b8af9ba6.t: Tubuhnya nyaris tanpa bobot saat ia memaksanya sampai batas; pikirannya yang berpacu menganalisis nyaris segala hal di penglihatannya dan menyesuaikan langkahnya. Ia merasakan tulang-tulangnya retak, sendi-sendinya jebol dan sembuh, hanya untuk jebol lagi.

d6c38c4309a7.en: Huneo launches into a long speech, until the crowd cuts him off: "Sanbi shit! Are you gonna talk all day or what? I got a fish to gut!" He skips several pages. "Thank you all, and—and I hope to earn your trust." The crowd claps, erratically but energetically, not quite sure what to make of this uptight Forway lookalike.
d6c38c4309a7.t: Huneo memulai pidato panjang, sampai kerumunan memotongnya: "Tahi Sanbi! Kamu mau ngomong seharian atau apa? Aku punya ikan yang harus dibersihkan!" Ia melewatkan beberapa halaman. "Terima kasih semuanya, dan—dan saya harap bisa mendapat kepercayaan kalian." Kerumunan bertepuk tangan, tidak beraturan tapi bersemangat, tak terlalu yakin harus bagaimana menanggapi orang kaku yang mirip orang Forway ini.

d6facdc6ed58.en: Crying, she tries to reach the flowers on the desk, flailing as screams and fighting break out outside. She stands, falls forward against the table, grabs all the flowers and shoves them in her mouth. She smiles, tries to get up, and hobbles to the floor.
d6facdc6ed58.t: Sambil menangis, ia berusaha meraih bunga-bunga di meja, menggapai-gapai saat jeritan dan perkelahian pecah di luar. Ia berdiri, jatuh ke depan menimpa meja, meraih semua bunga dan menjejalkannya ke mulutnya. Ia tersenyum, berusaha bangun, dan tertatih jatuh ke lantai.

d74a2d3d2fe0.en: Neferteri stops, but doesn't turn back. "You killed Huneo. Do you realize what you've done?" "I KILLED HARRY COUNTLESS TIMES! WHAT'S THE DIFFERENCE?" "One of them was considered an experimental subject." She starts walking away. "That was until I saw you needlessly mutilating his corpse."
d74a2d3d2fe0.t: Neferteri berhenti, tapi tidak berbalik. "Kamu membunuh Huneo. Kamu sadar apa yang kamu lakukan?" "AKU SUDAH MEMBUNUH HARRY BERKALI-KALI! APA BEDANYA?" "Salah satunya dianggap subjek eksperimen." Ia mulai berjalan pergi. "Itu sampai aku melihatmu memutilasi jasadnya tanpa perlu."

d781df849777.en: "Why didn't you tell me?" "I still don't know who would do such a thing to Harry and Sinoi, or why. I wanted to talk to you once I had something tangible, but I'm afraid I haven't found anything of value yet." "Then issue a search quest!" "And put his only possible excuse in jeopardy? If I don't invoke the clauses of our contract, Sinoi has a chance to convince whoever captured him that he has no ties to us."
d781df849777.t: "Kenapa Anda tidak memberitahuku?" "Aku masih tidak tahu siapa yang akan melakukan hal seperti itu kepada Harry dan Sinoi, atau kenapa. Aku ingin bicara denganmu begitu aku punya sesuatu yang nyata, tapi sayangnya aku belum menemukan apa pun yang berharga." "Kalau begitu pasang misi pencarian!" "Dan membahayakan satu-satunya alasan yang mungkin ia punya? Kalau aku tidak memberlakukan klausul kontrak kita, Sinoi punya peluang meyakinkan siapa pun yang menangkapnya bahwa ia tak punya hubungan dengan kita."

d897627cb50b.en: Chapter 1 - Sanbi’s Four Power Players XX, XX 1040 meeting.
d897627cb50b.t: Bab 1 - Rapat Empat Pemain Kekuasaan Sanbi XX, XX 1040.

da528f403398.en: Kibe: "You're still finding his journals?" Huneo: "The guard captains raided a personal stash of his at the Forway scientific school."
da528f403398.t: Kibe: "Kamu masih menemukan jurnal-jurnalnya?" Huneo: "Para kapten penjaga menggerebek simpanan pribadinya di sekolah ilmiah Forway."

da8e284745fd.en: She's Katsuki, Katsumi's twin, and she's high on sedatives. The guy stops, pushes her onto the bed, and she flops around; she tries to get up, but her body won't quite respond. He gets dressed, grabs his weapon and leaves.
da8e284745fd.t: Ia adalah Katsuki, kembaran Katsumi, dan ia teler karena obat penenang. Pria itu berhenti, mendorongnya ke kasur, dan tubuhnya terkulai lemas; ia berusaha bangun, tapi tubuhnya tak sepenuhnya menurut. Pria itu berpakaian, meraih senjatanya, dan pergi.

db431c6b71ee.en: Harry feels all his muscles bulge, and I mean all of them. The chicken jerky with Black Honey tastes amazing. Clodoveu, finishing Harry's haircut, looks interested; Wilson tries not to laugh, and fails. "So that's the real reason you wanted him on the team." Clodoveu smiles. "Hey! I like twinks and Woolies alike." (Woolies: slang for burly, hairy men.)
db431c6b71ee.t: Harry merasakan semua ototnya menggembung, dan maksudku semuanya. Dendeng ayam dengan Black Honey itu rasanya luar biasa. Clodoveu, yang sedang menyelesaikan potongan rambut Harry, tampak tertarik; Wilson berusaha menahan tawa, dan gagal. "Jadi itu alasan sebenarnya kamu mau dia di tim." Clodoveu tersenyum. "Hei! Aku suka twink dan Wooly sama-sama." (Wooly: istilah gaul untuk pria kekar berbulu.)

db7d44b21fbe.en: Huneo opens his arms. "C'mon! Do it! I know you want to kill me! DO IT!" Eori falls for the trap: she kills him, and laughs as she bashes his head on the ground. (Huneo comes back later: Neferteri needs him, and she has his freshly dead corpse for the revival.)
db7d44b21fbe.t: Huneo membuka lengannya. "Ayo! Lakukan! Aku tahu kamu ingin membunuhku! LAKUKAN!" Eori masuk perangkap: ia membunuhnya, dan tertawa sambil membenturkan kepalanya ke lantai. (Huneo kembali nanti: Neferteri membutuhkannya, dan ia punya jasadnya yang baru mati untuk penghidupan kembali.)

dbbe2bf82bb6.en: "Going by the contract alone, you're delivering double the minimum required. But this is no longer about our contract; it's about your relationship with Harry."
dbbe2bf82bb6.t: "Menurut kontraknya saja, kamu menyerahkan dua kali lipat dari minimum yang diwajibkan. Tapi ini bukan lagi soal kontrak kita; ini soal hubunganmu dengan Harry."

dbc1ac158132.en: Eiri comes in and closes the door. "Are you guys abusing Sora?" Itanema: "C'mon now. This is your chance." Sora shakes her head into the pillow. "What's this all about?" "Argh. I guess I'll have to be the villain, then—I don't want this anymore. You're—"
dbc1ac158132.t: Eiri masuk dan menutup pintu. "Apa kalian merundung Sora?" Itanema: "Ayolah. Ini kesempatanmu." Sora menggeleng di dalam bantal. "Ada apa ini?" "Argh. Kurasa aku harus jadi penjahatnya, kalau begitu—aku tidak mau ini lagi. Kamu—"

dbea584ae58e.en: Harry #8-B stumbles onto an abandoned shack

dc06f6b4023c.en: Harry #9-B, soaked, watches the two bandits make more cold water
dc06f6b4023c.t: Harry #9-B, basah kuyup, mengawasi kedua bandit membuat lebih banyak air dingin

de0da974186f.en: Eiri asks for a day off to see Coema off. Neferteri can't stand hearing the name; she grips her badge and tells Eiri not to bring Coema here.
de0da974186f.t: Eiri meminta libur sehari untuk mengantar kepergian Coema. Neferteri tak tahan mendengar nama itu; ia mencengkeram lencananya dan menyuruh Eiri agar tidak membawa Coema ke sini.

de0e9ae7af70.en: Eiri: "This would even explain why Neferteri demanded that all of Harry's letters go through her. I really want to tell Itagiba, but if I do, it might just crumble the entire guild." She stands. "Girls. This conversation dies here, with us. Don't tell anyone else, or we'll be in a world of trouble."
de0e9ae7af70.t: Eiri: "Ini bahkan menjelaskan kenapa Neferteri menuntut agar semua surat Harry lewat dia. Aku sangat ingin memberi tahu Itagiba, tapi kalau begitu, seluruh gilda bisa hancur." Ia berdiri. "Para gadis. Percakapan ini berakhir di sini, bersama kita. Jangan beri tahu siapa pun, atau kita akan dapat masalah besar."

debe7caede34.en: Harry #7-A eats a fruit the Bagarisas scream at him about
debe7caede34.t: Harry #7-A memakan buah yang membuat para Bagarisa menjerit-jerit kepadanya

dfe33e38de48.en: Harry #8-C fights a bigger animal near sundown
dfe33e38de48.t: Harry #8-C melawan hewan yang lebih besar menjelang matahari terbenam

e04d41fced19.en: Aurora clears her throat. "Princesses?" They let go and sit down in unison, covered in a blanket of shame, looking away from each other. "Princess Eori, you were so busy with your nari gels that you never noticed Maiara's accomplishments in Homeegg. She's the glue that holds the Sanbi Kingdom team together."
e04d41fced19.t: Aurora berdeham. "Para Putri?" Mereka melepaskan dan duduk serempak, diselimuti rasa malu, saling membuang muka. "Putri Eori, Anda begitu sibuk dengan nari gel Anda sampai tak pernah memperhatikan prestasi Maiara di Homeegg. Dialah perekat yang menyatukan tim Kerajaan Sanbi."

e05add853200.en: She punches things, breaks things, smashes things, then curls up by the bed, crying. "I just wanted Harry!" A knock. "Leave me the fuck alone!"
e05add853200.t: Ia meninju barang, memecahkan barang, menghancurkan barang, lalu meringkuk di samping kasur, menangis. "Aku cuma ingin Harry!" Ketukan. "Tinggalkan aku sendiri, sialan!"

e2aee5ef0e62.en: Everyone struggles through the explosion. Dalila's father shields her. She wakes up in the branches of a tree, unable to move. She watches the last adventurer fight Harry and die at his hands.
e2aee5ef0e62.t: Semua orang bergulat menembus ledakan. Ayah Dalila melindunginya. Ia terbangun di dahan pohon, tak bisa bergerak. Ia menyaksikan petualang terakhir melawan Harry dan mati di tangannya.

e53ea5c1b0bf.en: "Princess—daughter Eori. My daughter Eori. When I said Harry would be under your care, I meant using him as a tool to further our scientific knowledge, and our kingdom into the future."
e53ea5c1b0bf.t: "Putri—putriku Eori. Putriku Eori. Saat aku bilang Harry akan berada di bawah asuhanmu, maksudku memakainya sebagai alat untuk memajukan pengetahuan ilmiah kita, dan kerajaan kita ke masa depan."

e5475e3cfa9d.en: The boss studies Harry's hand, smells it, tosses it aside, then watches the flames appear and disappear. He looks at Clodoveu. "Plan #237." He goes back to his chair. Clodoveu taps Wilson on the shoulder. "Can you grab Marcus this time?" Wilson gives a small, cowardly thumbs-up.
e5475e3cfa9d.t: Bos mengamati tangan Harry, mengendusnya, melemparnya ke samping, lalu memperhatikan api yang muncul dan hilang. Ia menatap Clodoveu. "Rencana #237." Ia kembali ke kursinya. Clodoveu menepuk bahu Wilson. "Bisa kamu ambil Marcus kali ini?" Wilson mengacungkan jempol kecil yang penakut.

e6ade5f6b103.en: Shady Black Magina riders on Eguas
e6ade5f6b103.t: Penunggang Black Magina yang mencurigakan di atas Egua

e6c11a250c86.en: Nina comes in holding a contract, smiling ear to ear, climbs onto a chair and, chest puffed out, unrolls it, trying to sound like a guard reading a sentence: "With the afore—mentioned clause—sules, Queen Neferteri shall terminate the contract, and the research funding."
e6c11a250c86.t: Nina masuk memegang kontrak, tersenyum lebar, naik ke kursi dan, dengan dada membusung, membuka gulungannya, berusaha terdengar seperti penjaga yang membacakan vonis: "Dengan klau—sula-sula yang telah—disebutkan, Ratu Neferteri akan mengakhiri kontrak, dan pendanaan risetnya."

e7377d9733ab.en: Death squeals outside; Harry pictures the Bagarisas dying. He grabs the arrow and rips it out in one swing, blood splattering everywhere, coughs up the blood filling his lungs and stands. Rage overtakes him, and he screams from deep in his gut.
e7377d9733ab.t: Pekikan kematian di luar; Harry membayangkan para Bagarisa sekarat. Ia mencengkeram anak panah itu dan mencabutnya dalam satu sentakan, darah memercik ke mana-mana, terbatuk mengeluarkan darah yang memenuhi paru-parunya, lalu berdiri. Amarah menguasainya, dan ia menjerit dari lubuk perutnya.

e76693f1758c.en: Clodoveu wears the same nari gel Arukia used to see in the dark. Harry: "So what do you guys even do?" "The usual. Stealing, sometimes kidnapping, mostly from the filthy rich. That's the Blue Wozens' motto." He shows his proof of membership. "The boss formed this bandit group a while ago, after some rich Forway families looked down on his family. They took advantage of him through contracts, until he realized he had a way out: flee the contract, and leech off the rich who once imprisoned him."
e76693f1758c.t: Clodoveu memakai nari gel yang sama yang dipakai Arukia untuk melihat dalam gelap. Harry: "Jadi sebenarnya kalian ini melakukan apa?" "Yang biasa. Mencuri, kadang menculik, kebanyakan dari orang kaya raya. Itu semboyan Blue Wozens." Ia menunjukkan bukti keanggotaannya. "Bos membentuk kelompok bandit ini beberapa waktu lalu, setelah beberapa keluarga kaya Forway memandang rendah keluarganya. Mereka memanfaatkannya lewat kontrak-kontrak, sampai ia sadar ia punya jalan keluar: kabur dari kontrak, dan mengisap orang-orang kaya yang dulu memenjarakannya."

e7964a37e572.en: Kibe and Huneo at the ceremony

e82a7387c182.en: Eiri pets Sora's head. I guess love does make people do all kinds of crazy shit— She stops in her tracks, remembering how pushy Neferteri was about getting Harry to sign the contract, and how much she put on the search quest. Did the Queen already know Eori loved Harry? But then why— "Oh crap! Harry and Eori were having a love affair this whole time!"
e82a7387c182.t: Eiri mengelus kepala Sora. Kurasa cinta memang membuat orang melakukan segala macam hal gila sialan— Ia berhenti melangkah, teringat betapa ngototnya Neferteri agar Harry menandatangani kontrak itu, dan betapa banyak yang ia pasang untuk misi pencarian. Apa Ratu sudah tahu Eori mencintai Harry? Tapi kalau begitu kenapa— "Astaga! Harry dan Eori sudah menjalin hubungan cinta selama ini!"

e85ac8f4c504.en: Harry #7-A shelters at the foot of a big tree as night and rain set in
e85ac8f4c504.t: Harry #7-A berlindung di kaki sebuah pohon besar saat malam dan hujan datang

e88037789ba9.en: Eori, alone in a room, tries to free herself
e88037789ba9.t: Eori, sendirian di sebuah kamar, berusaha membebaskan diri

e93b0d7f2059.en: She also wants them to look into Arukia's disappearance: the more she thinks about it, the more intertwined Arukia's actions seem. But they're to put their own safety above hers, since nobody knows what Arukia, or whoever controls her, really is.
e93b0d7f2059.t: Ia juga ingin mereka menyelidiki hilangnya Arukia: makin ia memikirkannya, makin tampak saling terkait tindakan-tindakan Arukia. Tapi mereka harus mendahulukan keselamatan mereka sendiri di atas keselamatannya, karena tak ada yang tahu apa sebenarnya Arukia, atau siapa pun yang mengendalikannya.

ea00dec5e74b.en: Ukim, the new maid who came after Arukia left, and the curious type, digs deeper: "Did Eori really say that? That's so sweet!" Sora shakes her head. "There's something wrong! I know it!" Itanema: "You guys only noticed now?" Everyone stops. "Why didn't you say anything?" "'Cause it wouldn't really change anything. Just connect the dots. It's that easy."
ea00dec5e74b.t: Ukim, pelayan baru yang datang setelah Arukia pergi, dan si tipe penasaran, mengorek lebih dalam: "Eori benar-benar bilang begitu? Manis sekali!" Sora menggeleng. "Ada yang tidak beres! Aku tahu itu!" Itanema: "Kalian baru sadar sekarang?" Semua berhenti. "Kenapa kamu tidak bilang apa-apa?" "Karena tidak akan banyak mengubah apa pun. Hubungkan saja titik-titiknya. Semudah itu."

ea0297bad0d1.en: Eori jumps up. "I NEVER SAID I LOVED HIM!" The guards step forward; she clenches her fists and sits back down, holding back a sea of emotions. Neferteri raises a hand, the guards step back, and she lets the awkward silence thicken.
ea0297bad0d1.t: Eori melompat berdiri. "AKU TIDAK PERNAH BILANG AKU MENCINTAINYA!" Para penjaga maju; ia mengepalkan tinju dan duduk kembali, menahan lautan emosi. Neferteri mengangkat tangan, para penjaga mundur, dan ia membiarkan keheningan yang canggung makin pekat.

ea5f1c87bd15.en: Clodoveu opens a bag of snacks with a huge smirk. "Right on. Tell me every single detail." Wilson sits too and reaches for a snack, until a look from Clodoveu stops him. "This better be spicy!" Harry, frozen, tells them everything he knows.
ea5f1c87bd15.t: Clodoveu membuka sekantong camilan dengan seringai lebar. "Mantap. Ceritakan setiap detailnya." Wilson juga duduk dan meraih camilan, sampai tatapan Clodoveu menghentikannya. "Ini sebaiknya pedas!" Harry, membeku, menceritakan semua yang ia tahu.

eb16ea3684af.en: Sora and Eiri, out with the guards, hear Eori scream
eb16ea3684af.t: Sora dan Eiri, sedang di luar bersama para penjaga, mendengar Eori menjerit

ec21a90c6135.en: Neferteri and Eori in her cell

ec85330874b5.en: Marcus spits out half-broken teeth, bleeding from his nose and mouth. "I don't want another faggot on my team." Wilson raises his hand, a tear in his eye. "I'm with Clodoveu. Harry's suffered enough." Marcus leaves. "Then you two can suck him off. I don't fucking care. Kozaku will put a stop to this."
ec85330874b5.t: Marcus meludahkan gigi yang setengah patah, berdarah dari hidung dan mulut. "Aku tidak mau banci lain di timku." Wilson mengangkat tangan, setetes air mata di matanya. "Aku bersama Clodoveu. Harry sudah cukup menderita." Marcus pergi. "Kalau begitu kalian berdua boleh mengisap kontolnya. Aku tidak peduli. Kozaku akan menghentikan ini."

ee9605f8b934.en: Stab! Stab! Stab! The ghost desperately stabs him in the back. He lets out an ear-piercing scream, his hand flares, and the ghost sizzles. He runs out of fire, but doesn't let go of that spongy thing. He tries to pump out more, but his grip is going.
ee9605f8b934.t: Tusuk! Tusuk! Tusuk! Hantu itu dengan putus asa menusuk punggungnya. Ia mengeluarkan jeritan memekakkan, tangannya berkobar, dan hantu itu mendesis terbakar. Apinya habis, tapi ia tak melepaskan benda kenyal itu. Ia berusaha memompa lebih banyak, tapi cengkeramannya melemah.

ef6d38fe423f.en: A hoarse voice: "I like 'em tight!" Thunder roars across the sky.
ef6d38fe423f.t: Suara serak: "Aku suka yang sempit!" Guntur menggelegar di langit.

efb210146664.en: Neferteri looks at her daughter, who stares back as if looking for trouble. Neferteri is speechless; she wants to say something, but struggles to find the words. She turns around. "Why am I still here?" Eori asks flat out.
efb210146664.t: Neferteri menatap putrinya, yang balas menatap seolah mencari masalah. Neferteri tak bisa berkata-kata; ia ingin mengatakan sesuatu, tapi kesulitan menemukan kata-katanya. Ia berbalik. "Kenapa aku masih di sini?" tanya Eori terang-terangan.

efbf557378a1.en: Sora and Aurora try to picture the dots and connect them, and can't. Itanema puts a hand to her mouth. "The walls say there's a love triangle between Arukia, Eori and Harry, and Harry dumped them both and disappeared with someone else." Aurora gasps and drops her tea; Sora is stuck in sheer disbelief. It clicks: all the time those three spent away from the castle, out of the public eye.
efbf557378a1.t: Sora dan Aurora berusaha membayangkan titik-titiknya dan menghubungkannya, dan tidak bisa. Itanema menaruh tangan di mulutnya. "Kata dinding, ada cinta segitiga antara Arukia, Eori, dan Harry, dan Harry mencampakkan keduanya dan menghilang bersama orang lain." Aurora terkesiap dan menjatuhkan tehnya; Sora terpaku tak percaya. Semuanya jadi masuk akal: semua waktu yang dihabiskan ketiganya jauh dari kastil, jauh dari mata publik.

f02af4af8c4c.en: "I gave you a fuckload of new nari gel! What about it?"
f02af4af8c4c.t: "Aku sudah memberimu nari gel baru sebanyak sialan! Terus kenapa?"

f213ceca3bf9.en: Near sundown, the Bagarisas find someone's remains not far from the shack and start chewing on them. Harry realizes it was a person and tells them to stop. The clothes are an older woman's. He calls inside, but no one answers.
f213ceca3bf9.t: Menjelang matahari terbenam, para Bagarisa menemukan sisa-sisa seseorang tak jauh dari gubuk dan mulai mengunyahnya. Harry sadar itu dulunya manusia dan menyuruh mereka berhenti. Pakaiannya milik seorang wanita tua. Ia memanggil ke dalam, tapi tak ada yang menjawab.

f2b1a0f179ba.en: Neferteri hands her a map with X marks around Sanbi, Cruroland, Sundeath and Freeish. "Sinoi was helping Harry move around, while keeping a close eye on him. He disappeared at the same time as Harry."
f2b1a0f179ba.t: Neferteri memberinya peta dengan tanda-tanda X di sekitar Sanbi, Cruroland, Sundeath, dan Freeish. "Sinoi membantu Harry berpindah-pindah, sambil mengawasinya dengan ketat. Dia menghilang bersamaan dengan Harry."

f3d5406c19d6.en: Takeo stands and dusts off his robes. "Phew. That's over." Severino coughs up dirt as he gets up a ways off. "What makes you say that?" "That's what I heard from Sapphire adventurers: an explosion like that matches the Hifuna beasts when they reach the end of their lives. We should go check it out! And if we're first, can I claim to be the one who slayed it? I'm very close to my Sapphire promotion." "Well, if you protect us, then have at it." Takeo holds out his hand, and they shake firmly.
f3d5406c19d6.t: Takeo berdiri dan menepuk-nepuk jubahnya. "Fiuh. Sudah selesai." Severino terbatuk mengeluarkan tanah saat bangun agak jauh dari situ. "Kenapa kamu bilang begitu?" "Itu yang kudengar dari para petualang Sapphire: ledakan seperti itu cocok dengan makhluk buas Hifuna saat mencapai akhir hidupnya. Kita harus memeriksanya! Dan kalau kita yang pertama, boleh aku mengaku sebagai yang membunuhnya? Aku sudah sangat dekat dengan kenaikan pangkat Sapphire-ku." "Yah, kalau kamu melindungi kami, silakan." Takeo mengulurkan tangan, dan mereka berjabat tangan erat.

f3f3786daa19.en: Eori works for Huneo, guards at the door, a guard captain at his side
f3f3786daa19.t: Eori bekerja untuk Huneo, penjaga di pintu, seorang kapten penjaga di sampingnya

f539610df70d.en: It ends with darkness splitting Harry from the Bagarisas. He tries to run to them, but the split is too strong. Then a bright light hits him.
f539610df70d.t: Ini berakhir dengan kegelapan memisahkan Harry dari para Bagarisa. Ia berusaha berlari ke arah mereka, tapi pemisahnya terlalu kuat. Lalu cahaya terang menghantamnya.

f71b004edf0a.en: Katsuki watches from the barred window

f75b653b3e95.en: Dalila readies a sigil ring. "I wanna do Ice!" "Fine by me. Just release it after us!" She prepares the spell. They all see something rush through the forest and leap at them.
f75b653b3e95.t: Dalila menyiapkan cincin sigil. "Aku mau pakai Ice!" "Boleh. Lepaskan saja setelah kami!" Ia menyiapkan mantranya. Mereka semua melihat sesuatu menerjang menembus hutan dan melompat ke arah mereka.

f9159e5a6663.en: Clodoveu bumps Harry's shoulder. "Quite the surprise, huh?" "So who is the boss?" Clodoveu tells him: Kozaku was born in Forway City to mixed-blood parents who left Gandew. Pure-blood Darfaries' smugness always rubbed him the wrong way, and after he signed a rich man's contract without reading the fine print, the rich man's family harassed him, so he founded the Blue Wozens with two others and struck back. Marcus downs his beer, impatient with all the boss talk; Clodoveu ignores him.
f9159e5a6663.t: Clodoveu menyenggol bahu Harry. "Cukup mengejutkan, ya?" "Jadi siapa bosnya?" Clodoveu menceritakannya: Kozaku lahir di Forway City dari orang tua berdarah campuran yang meninggalkan Gandew. Keangkuhan Darfaries berdarah murni selalu membuatnya kesal, dan setelah ia menandatangani kontrak seorang pria kaya tanpa membaca ketentuan kecilnya, keluarga pria kaya itu merongrongnya, jadi ia mendirikan Blue Wozens bersama dua orang lain dan membalas. Marcus menenggak birnya, tak sabar dengan semua omongan tentang bos; Clodoveu mengabaikannya.

fa3226bf4e4c.en: Chunks of meat and fur on a makeshift spit, a bloodied stone on the side. Disgusted, he eats it anyway, spitting out fur. The Bagarisas want some, so he gives them all of it, and they clean their plate.
fa3226bf4e4c.t: Potongan daging dan bulu di pemanggang darurat, sebongkah batu berlumur darah di sampingnya. Jijik, ia tetap memakannya, sambil meludahkan bulu. Para Bagarisa menginginkannya, jadi ia memberikan semuanya, dan mereka menghabiskannya sampai bersih.

fa747c82ad01.en: Neferteri with Morika, Namia and Posaqui
fa747c82ad01.t: Neferteri bersama Morika, Namia, dan Posaqui

fa7d7c23eb38.en: "Harry." Itagiba says it just as the door is about to close, then smiles. "You want to see him, right?" Eori stops in the doorway, hiding her face. Neferteri lays a hand on her husband's strong arm. "At this rate, we'll have to cut unnecessary expenses in the coming weeks, and Harry's search quest is one of them." "Why?" "Simply because we're implementing Huneo's strategies to improve our kingdom."
fa7d7c23eb38.t: "Harry." Itagiba mengatakannya tepat saat pintu hampir tertutup, lalu tersenyum. "Kamu ingin bertemu dengannya, kan?" Eori berhenti di ambang pintu, menyembunyikan wajahnya. Neferteri meletakkan tangan di lengan kekar suaminya. "Dengan laju begini, kita harus memangkas pengeluaran yang tidak perlu dalam beberapa minggu ke depan, dan misi pencarian Harry salah satunya." "Kenapa?" "Semata-mata karena kita sedang menerapkan strategi Huneo untuk memperbaiki kerajaan kita."

fb32b202048c.en: "HAAARRRRYYY!!!! I LLLLOOOOOVVEEE YOOOUU!" echoes through the bustling city night, and the city goes quiet as everyone tries to figure out what just happened.
fb32b202048c.t: "HAAARRRRYYY!!!! AKU CIIINNNTAAA KAAAMUUU!" menggema di malam kota yang ramai, dan kota pun hening saat semua orang berusaha mencari tahu apa yang baru saja terjadi.

fe4ee9b25685.en: Ryo, Katsumi and the adventurer reach the farm at night; smoke billows from the houses, small fires everywhere
fe4ee9b25685.t: Ryo, Katsumi, dan si petualang tiba di ladang pada malam hari; asap mengepul dari rumah-rumah, api kecil di mana-mana

fe802cdb219c.en: Harry feels the pressure of being near him. Clodoveu is his usual bluntly troglodyte self; Wilson mostly hides behind Clodoveu; Marcus crosses his arms, almost daring the boss to fight. "Loot?" "Some of it rotted, but we brought back everything we could. Plus, we found a fourth member." "Tsk," Marcus mutters.
fe802cdb219c.t: Harry merasakan tekanan berada di dekatnya. Clodoveu tetap dirinya yang blak-blakan bak manusia gua; Wilson kebanyakan bersembunyi di belakang Clodoveu; Marcus menyilangkan lengan, nyaris menantang bos untuk bertarung. "Jarahan?" "Sebagian busuk, tapi kami membawa kembali semua yang bisa kami bawa. Plus, kami menemukan anggota keempat." "Cih," gumam Marcus.

ff208bf7ac12.en: "Clodoveu told me all about you. How did the Sanbi scientist make it happen?" "Who, Gabiro? Yeah, I never met the guy. Eiri was the one who told me about him." "Did they give any details about what they did?" He shakes his head. "I had no memories of anything, so they probably didn't bother explaining."
ff208bf7ac12.t: "Clodoveu menceritakan semua tentangmu. Bagaimana ilmuwan Sanbi itu mewujudkannya?" "Siapa, Gabiro? Ya, aku tak pernah bertemu orangnya. Eiri yang menceritakan tentang dia." "Apa mereka memberi detail tentang apa yang mereka lakukan?" Ia menggeleng. "Aku tak punya ingatan apa pun, jadi mereka mungkin tidak repot-repot menjelaskan."

ffc69d1296d5.en: Harry explodes in fire as his soul weakens; Dalila's father shields her
ffc69d1296d5.t: Harry meledak dalam api saat jiwanya melemah; ayah Dalila melindunginya
